CAM-01.params: locked axis (X / Y / both) · screen anchor · follow smoothing · max follow speed · teleport snap threshold · camera bounds
CAM-01.impl: Convert the target position to the desired camera transform that keeps it at a fixed normalized screen anchor, then update only the selected axes. Apply optional damping during ordinary movement, but snap when displacement exceeds a teleport threshold, and constrain the result after following.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入角色固定位置跟隨：以 320×180 畫面為基準，把角色固定在畫面寬度 40%、高度 55% 的位置，水平與垂直軸都跟隨；一般移動用 0.12 秒平滑，角色瞬移超過 96 px 時立即對齊，最後套用關卡邊界。
prompt.en: In your game, add locked-position following: for a 320×180 reference frame, keep the character at 40% of the screen width and 55% of its height, following on both axes. Smooth ordinary motion over 0.12 s, snap immediately after teleports greater than 96 px, and apply level bounds last.
prompt.ja: ゲームに画面位置固定の追従を追加して。基準解像度 320×180 で、キャラクターを画面幅 40%、高さ 55% の位置に保ち、縦横の両軸を追従させる。通常移動は 0.12 秒で平滑化し、96 px を超えるワープ時は即座に合わせ、最後にステージ境界で制限する。

CAM-02.params: window width/height · window offset · per-axis enable · boundary response · follow smoothing · maximum lag
CAM-02.impl: Define a rectangle in screen space around the desired composition. Leave the camera unchanged while the target remains inside it; when the target crosses an edge, move the camera by the minimum amount needed to place the target back on that edge.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入活動死區：以 320×180 畫面為基準，在中央設 80×44 px 的跟隨窗口；角色在窗口內走動時鏡頭完全不動，越過任何邊界後才以 0.18 秒平滑推動鏡頭，並只修正足以把角色放回邊界的距離。
prompt.en: In your game, add a movement dead zone: on a 320×180 reference frame, place an 80×44 px follow window at the centre. Keep the camera completely still while the character is inside it; after any edge is crossed, move with 0.18 s smoothing and correct only enough to return the character to that edge.
prompt.ja: ゲームに移動デッドゾーンを追加して。基準解像度 320×180 の中央に 80×44 px の追従ウィンドウを置く。キャラクターが内側にいる間はカメラを完全に止め、境界を越えた時だけ 0.18 秒で滑らかに動かし、キャラクターを境界まで戻す最小距離だけ補正する。

CAM-03.params: dead-zone size · soft-zone size · response curve · damping time · hard-limit margin · per-axis weighting
CAM-03.impl: Use nested screen-space regions: zero correction in the inner dead zone, a correction weight that rises with distance through the soft zone, and full correction at the outer limit. Keep region dimensions separate from damping so designers can tune when following begins independently from how quickly it responds.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入柔性追趕區：中央 48×28 px 為完全不動的死區，外圍 128×72 px 為軟區；角色進入軟區後，跟隨強度由 0 平滑增加至 100%，阻尼時間設 0.25 秒；角色到達外框時必須停止繼續偏離。
prompt.en: In your game, add a soft catch-up zone: use a 48×28 px central dead zone and a 128×72 px outer soft zone. As the character enters the soft zone, raise follow strength smoothly from 0% to 100% with 0.25 s damping, and prevent any further screen-space drift at the outer boundary.
prompt.ja: ゲームにソフト追従領域を追加して。中央の 48×28 px は完全に動かないデッドゾーン、その外側の 128×72 px はソフトゾーンにする。キャラクターがソフトゾーンへ入ったら追従量を 0% から 100% まで滑らかに増やし、減衰時間は 0.25 秒。外枠に達したらそれ以上画面端へずれないようにする。

CAM-04.params: position smooth time · rotation smooth time · max speed · damping model · per-axis damping · teleport threshold
CAM-04.impl: Filter the desired position and orientation with a critically damped spring or another frame-rate-independent smoothing function. Store velocity as part of the camera state, cap extreme speeds, and bypass the filter for teleports or scene resets.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入柔順跟隨：鏡頭位置以臨界阻尼彈簧追向角色，水平平滑時間 0.18 秒、垂直 0.28 秒，最高速度 900 px/秒；角色停下後容許鏡頭繼續收斂，但位移突然超過 128 px 時直接重設，避免長距離飛過畫面。
prompt.en: In your game, add smooth following with a critically damped spring: use a 0.18 s horizontal smooth time, 0.28 s vertical smooth time, and a 900 px/s speed cap. Let the camera continue settling after the character stops, but reset directly when displacement suddenly exceeds 128 px.
prompt.ja: ゲームに滑らかな追従を追加して。カメラ位置を臨界減衰ばねでキャラクターへ追従させ、平滑化時間は横 0.18 秒、縦 0.28 秒、最高速度は 900 px/秒。キャラクター停止後も収束を続けるが、差が急に 128 px を超えた場合は直接リセットして長距離を飛ばさない。

CAM-05.params: landing height threshold · grounded confirmation · realign delay · vertical smooth time · jump lock · drop-through rule
CAM-05.impl: Hold the camera's vertical reference while the character is airborne, then update the reference from the confirmed landing surface. Ignore brief ground contacts, and smooth toward the new platform height unless the height change exceeds a deliberate snap threshold.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入落地才重新對齊：普通跳躍期間鎖住鏡頭高度；角色連續着地 0.08 秒，而且新平台與舊參考高度相差至少 24 px 時，才用 0.3 秒 ease-in-out 對齊新高度。從單向平台向下穿越時不要把短暫接觸當成落地。
prompt.en: In your game, realign camera height only on landing: lock the vertical camera reference during normal jumps. After the character has remained grounded for 0.08 s and the new platform differs by at least 24 px, ease to its height over 0.3 s; ignore brief contacts while dropping through one-way platforms.
prompt.ja: ゲームで、着地時だけカメラの高さを合わせ直して。通常ジャンプ中は縦の基準を固定し、キャラクターが 0.08 秒連続で接地し、新しい足場が以前の基準から 24 px 以上違う時だけ、0.3 秒のイーズイン・アウトで新しい高さへ移す。一方向床を下へ抜ける時の短い接触は着地扱いにしない。

CAM-06.params: prediction time · max look-ahead · speed threshold · acceleration smoothing · recenter time · vertical contribution
CAM-06.impl: Estimate a projected focus from filtered target velocity, clamp its offset, and add it to the normal follow target. Use hysteresis around zero velocity and usually reduce or disable the vertical component so jumping does not make the view bob.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入速度預測前視：以角色最近 0.12 秒的平均水平速度預測前方 0.35 秒，把焦點最多偏移 56 px；速度低於 20 px/秒時不增加偏移，轉向後用 0.22 秒過渡，停下則用 0.4 秒回正。垂直速度只採用 20%，避免跳躍令畫面上下搖。
prompt.en: In your game, add velocity-predictive look-ahead: average the character's horizontal velocity over 0.12 s, project 0.35 s ahead, and clamp the focus offset to 56 px. Add no offset below 20 px/s, transition direction over 0.22 s, recenter over 0.4 s when stopped, and use only 20% of vertical velocity.
prompt.ja: ゲームに速度予測の先読みを追加して。直近 0.12 秒のキャラクターの平均水平速度から 0.35 秒先を予測し、注視点のずれは最大 56 px。20 px/秒未満ではずらさず、方向転換は 0.22 秒、停止後の中央復帰は 0.4 秒。ジャンプで上下に揺れないよう垂直速度は 20% だけ使う。

CAM-07.params: region volume · composition anchor · camera height · zoom/distance · region priority · transition duration · overlap hysteresis
CAM-07.impl: Associate each level region with a camera-state preset containing its anchor, viewing distance, and framing rules. Resolve overlapping regions by explicit priority and hysteresis, then hand the selected state to a separate cut or blend system.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入分區構圖錨點：洞穴區把焦點放在入口上方 32 px，正交可見高度設 180 px；Boss 房把焦點設在房間中心，可見高度擴至 260 px。角色進入區域內 24 px 後才切換規則，重疊時 Boss 房優先，並用 0.6 秒平滑交接。
prompt.en: In your game, add region-based composition anchors: in the cave, focus 32 px above the entrance with a 180 px orthographic visible height; in the boss room, focus on the room centre and widen to 260 px. Switch only after the character moves 24 px inside a region, give the boss room priority on overlap, and blend over 0.6 s.
prompt.ja: ゲームに領域ごとの構図アンカーを追加して。洞窟では入口の 32 px 上を注視し、正投影の表示高さを 180 px にする。ボス部屋では部屋中央を注視し、表示高さを 260 px に広げる。領域へ 24 px 入ってから規則を切り替え、重複時はボス部屋を優先し、0.6 秒で滑らかに遷移する。

CAM-08.params: region weight · character weight · maximum offset · weight falloff · smoothing time · anchor radius
CAM-08.impl: Compute a persistent weighted focus between the region anchor and the character rather than waiting for the camera to catch the character fully. Clamp the character-induced offset and smooth the resulting focus before applying camera bounds.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入區域與角色混合重心：謎題房內的鏡頭焦點固定採用房間中心 75%、角色位置 25%，角色造成的偏移最多 48 px；焦點以 0.25 秒平滑移動。即使角色停下，鏡頭也不要最終移到角色正中央。
prompt.en: In your game, blend region and character focus in the puzzle room: set the camera focus to 75% room centre and 25% character position, clamp the character-driven offset to 48 px, and smooth it over 0.25 s. Even after the character stops, do not eventually centre the view fully on them.
prompt.ja: ゲームのパズル部屋で、領域とキャラクターの注視点を混ぜて。カメラの焦点を部屋中央 75%、キャラクター位置 25% とし、キャラクターによるずれは最大 48 px、0.25 秒で平滑化する。停止後もキャラクターを完全な中央へ移さないこと。

CAM-09.params: boundary shape · viewport padding · aspect ratio · zoom-aware inset · soft edge distance · fallback for small rooms
CAM-09.impl: Inset the allowed world shape by the camera's current half-extents, then project the desired camera centre onto that reduced shape. Recompute the inset when zoom or aspect ratio changes, and define a fallback centre when the room is smaller than the viewport.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入鏡頭邊界限制：用房間多邊形定義可見範圍，先按目前畫面半寬、半高把邊界向內縮，再限制鏡頭中心；四邊保留 8 px 安全邊距。16:9 與 21:9、以及縮放改變時都重新計算，確保畫面永遠不露出地圖外空白。
prompt.en: In your game, add camera boundary constraints using a room polygon. Inset it by the current viewport half-width and half-height, plus an 8 px safety margin, then constrain the camera centre to the reduced shape. Recompute for 16:9, 21:9, and every zoom change so no space outside the map is revealed.
prompt.ja: ゲームにカメラ境界制限を追加して。部屋のポリゴンを可視範囲とし、現在の画面の半幅・半高と 8 px の安全余白だけ内側へ縮めてから、カメラ中心をその領域に制限する。16:9、21:9、ズーム変更時に再計算し、マップ外の空白を見せない。

CAM-10.params: orbit radius · yaw sensitivity · pitch range · rotation smoothing · target height · collision radius · invert Y
CAM-10.impl: Represent orbit orientation as yaw and pitch around a target pivot, clamp pitch before converting the angles and radius to a camera position, and look back at the pivot. Resolve camera collision along the pivot-to-camera segment and preserve the player's yaw while the character turns.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入繞角色旋轉鏡頭：樞軸設在角色腰以上 1.2 m，半徑 4.5 m；右搖桿每秒最多轉 150°，俯仰限制在 −25° 至 65°，旋轉用 0.08 秒平滑。角色轉身不要自動改變鏡頭 yaw，並以半徑 0.25 m 的碰撞體避免鏡頭穿牆。
prompt.en: In your game, add an orbit camera around a pivot 1.2 m above the character with a 4.5 m radius. Let the right stick rotate up to 150°/s, clamp pitch from −25° to 65°, and smooth rotation over 0.08 s. Character turning must not overwrite camera yaw; use a 0.25 m collision radius against walls.
prompt.ja: ゲームにキャラクター周回カメラを追加して。支点はキャラクターの腰より 1.2 m 上、半径は 4.5 m。右スティックで最大 150°/秒、ピッチは −25°〜65°、回転は 0.08 秒で平滑化する。キャラクターが向きを変えてもカメラの yaw は変えず、半径 0.25 m の衝突判定で壁抜けを防ぐ。

CAM-11.params: shoulder offset · camera distance/height · aim convergence distance · shoulder-swap time · FOV · collision response · reticle bias
CAM-11.impl: Offset the camera laterally from a character-relative pivot while aiming through a separate screen-centre ray. For accurate aiming, resolve the reticle's world hit first and aim the weapon toward that point, then handle near-wall collision independently.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入越肩鏡頭：鏡頭置於角色後方 3.2 m、高 1.6 m、向右偏 0.55 m，垂直 FOV 55°；瞄準點由畫面中央射線決定。按鍵換肩時在 0.2 秒內把偏移由 +0.55 m 轉成 −0.55 m，鏡頭撞牆時推近，但不要讓準星跳離原本命中點。
prompt.en: In your game, add an over-the-shoulder camera 3.2 m behind, 1.6 m high, and 0.55 m to the character's right, with a 55° vertical FOV. Determine aim from a screen-centre ray; on shoulder swap, blend the offset from +0.55 m to −0.55 m over 0.2 s. Push the camera inward near walls without making the reticle jump off its hit point.
prompt.ja: ゲームに肩越しカメラを追加して。キャラクターの後方 3.2 m、高さ 1.6 m、右へ 0.55 m、垂直 FOV は 55°。照準点は画面中央のレイで決める。肩切り替え時は 0.2 秒で +0.55 m から −0.55 m へ補間し、壁際ではカメラを近づけるが、レティクルの命中点は跳ばせない。

CAM-12.params: idle delay · recenter reference · yaw speed · pitch return · input threshold · movement threshold · cancel conditions
CAM-12.impl: After manual camera input becomes idle, derive a target heading from character facing or filtered movement direction and rotate toward it on the shortest arc. Reset the idle timer immediately on fresh camera input and use separate speeds for yaw and pitch return.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入自動回正：右搖桿輸入低於 0.12 並持續 1.2 秒後，鏡頭以每秒 90° 的速度轉到角色移動方向後方；俯仰則在 0.5 秒內回到 12°。角色速度低於 0.5 m/s 時暫停回正，玩家再次推搖桿便立即取消。
prompt.en: In your game, add automatic recentering: after right-stick input stays below 0.12 for 1.2 s, rotate toward a position behind the character's movement direction at 90°/s, while pitch returns to 12° over 0.5 s. Pause recentering below 0.5 m/s and cancel it immediately when the player moves the stick again.
prompt.ja: ゲームに自動リセンターを追加して。右スティック入力が 0.12 未満のまま 1.2 秒続いたら、キャラクターの移動方向の背後へ 90°/秒で回し、ピッチは 0.5 秒で 12°へ戻す。速度が 0.5 m/秒未満なら停止し、再びスティックを動かしたら即座に解除する。

CAM-13.params: target weights · edge margin · min/max distance · min/max FOV · framing axis · expand/contract smoothing · target exclusion
CAM-13.impl: Build a weighted bounding volume around all active targets, centre the camera on it, and derive either distance or FOV needed to fit it with margins. Use asymmetric smoothing so widening happens faster than tightening, preventing a target from briefly leaving frame.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入多人同框構圖：每幀計算兩名玩家與 Boss 的包圍框，四邊保留畫面 10% 邊距；鏡頭距離限制在 6–18 m，垂直 FOV 限制在 45–68°。目標分開時用 0.25 秒拉闊，靠近時用 0.7 秒收近；已死亡目標在 1 秒後移除。
prompt.en: In your game, frame two players and the boss together: compute their bounds every frame with a 10% screen margin on all sides, clamp camera distance to 6–18 m and vertical FOV to 45–68°. Widen over 0.25 s when targets separate, tighten over 0.7 s when they regroup, and remove defeated targets after 1 s.
prompt.ja: ゲームで 2 人のプレイヤーとボスを同じ画面に収めて。毎フレーム全対象の範囲を求め、四辺に画面の 10% の余白を取る。カメラ距離は 6〜18 m、垂直 FOV は 45〜68°。離れる時は 0.25 秒で広げ、集まる時は 0.7 秒で寄せ、倒れた対象は 1 秒後に除外する。

CAM-14.params: collision shape radius · skin distance · obstacle layers · minimum distance · push-in speed · recovery speed · side-slide bias
CAM-14.impl: Sweep a sphere or capsule from the target pivot toward the desired camera position and place the camera just before the nearest blocking surface. Move inward quickly when blocked and restore distance more slowly after clearance to avoid popping at wall edges.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入鏡頭避牆：從角色樞軸向理想鏡頭位置做半徑 0.25 m 的球形掃描，命中牆壁時停在表面前 0.08 m，最短距離 0.6 m；推近用 0.06 秒，牆壁離開後用 0.35 秒恢復原距離。忽略角色與可穿透粒子。
prompt.en: In your game, add camera collision: sphere-sweep from the character pivot to the desired camera position with a 0.25 m radius, stopping 0.08 m before the nearest wall and never closer than 0.6 m. Push in over 0.06 s, restore distance over 0.35 s after clearance, and ignore the character and non-solid particles.
prompt.ja: ゲームにカメラの壁回避を追加して。キャラクターの支点から理想位置まで半径 0.25 m の球をスイープし、最も近い壁の 0.08 m 手前で止め、最短距離は 0.6 m。押し込みは 0.06 秒、壁がなくなった後の復帰は 0.35 秒。キャラクター自身と非実体パーティクルは無視する。

CAM-15.params: line-of-sight probes · obstruction grace time · candidate angles · camera radius · solution hold time · return smoothing · target visibility ratio
CAM-15.impl: Test line of sight from several camera samples to important target points, then score collision-free candidate positions around the target by visibility and deviation from the desired view. Hold a chosen solution briefly and add hysteresis so thin pillars do not make the camera alternate sides every frame.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入遮擋避讓：由鏡頭向角色頭、胸、腳三點射線檢查；超過 50% 探測點被擋 0.12 秒後，在目前角度左右各搜尋 15°、30°、45° 的候選位置，選擇改動最小而至少看見兩點的位置。新角度保持最少 0.4 秒，障礙消失後用 0.5 秒返回。
prompt.en: In your game, preserve line of sight with rays to the character's head, chest, and feet. If more than 50% are blocked for 0.12 s, test candidate positions at ±15°, ±30°, and ±45° around the current view, choosing the smallest change that reveals at least two points. Hold it for 0.4 s minimum and return over 0.5 s.
prompt.ja: ゲームに遮蔽回避を追加して。カメラからキャラクターの頭・胸・足へ 3 本のレイを飛ばし、50% を超える点が 0.12 秒隠れたら、現在角度の左右 ±15°、±30°、±45° を候補として調べる。2 点以上見える最小変更の位置を選び、最低 0.4 秒保持し、障害が消えたら 0.5 秒で戻す。

CAM-16.params: vertical FOV · near/far clip · aspect ratio · camera distance · lens shift · depth precision
CAM-16.impl: Use a perspective projection matrix so projected size decreases with view-space depth. Choose the field-of-view axis explicitly, derive the other axis from aspect ratio, and keep the near plane as far out as practical to preserve depth-buffer precision.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中使用透視投影：主探索鏡頭採垂直 FOV 55°、近裁切 0.1 m、遠裁切 500 m，以 16:9 為構圖基準並按長寬比推算水平 FOV。放置兩個同高 2 m 的柱，距離鏡頭 5 m 與 15 m，確保遠柱在畫面上明顯較小。
prompt.en: In your game, use perspective projection for the exploration camera: 55° vertical FOV, 0.1 m near clip, 500 m far clip, with composition based on 16:9 and horizontal FOV derived from aspect ratio. Place two 2 m pillars at 5 m and 15 m to verify that the farther pillar is visibly smaller on screen.
prompt.ja: ゲームの探索カメラに透視投影を使って。垂直 FOV 55°、近クリップ 0.1 m、遠クリップ 500 m、16:9 を構図基準にして水平 FOV はアスペクト比から求める。高さ 2 m の柱を 5 m と 15 m に置き、遠い柱が画面上で明確に小さくなることを確認する。

CAM-17.params: visible height/width · aspect handling · camera angle · near/far clip · pixel snapping · zoom limits
CAM-17.impl: Use an orthographic projection whose scale is defined by visible world height or width, not FOV. Recalculate the opposite dimension from aspect ratio, and for pixel art align the final camera transform to the world-units-per-pixel grid.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中使用正交投影：以 320×180 為基準，鏡頭顯示 180 個世界像素高，寬度按視窗長寬比延伸；每個世界像素對齊實際像素格，鏡頭位置亦取整。放置兩個同為 32 px 高、但深度相差 10 m 的角色，兩者畫面高度必須一致。
prompt.en: In your game, use an orthographic view based on 320×180: show 180 world pixels vertically and extend width with the window aspect ratio. Align world pixels and the camera position to the physical pixel grid. Two 32 px-tall characters separated by 10 m in depth must remain the same height on screen.
prompt.ja: ゲームで 320×180 基準の正投影を使って。縦に 180 ワールドピクセルを表示し、横幅はウィンドウのアスペクト比に合わせて広げる。ワールドピクセルとカメラ位置を実ピクセル格子へ揃える。奥行きが 10 m 違う高さ 32 px のキャラクター 2 体が、画面上で同じ高さになるようにする。

CAM-18.params: base vertical FOV · target FOV · transition time · aspect ratio · speed mapping · aim override · comfort limit
CAM-18.impl: Animate the projection's FOV while leaving camera position unchanged, preferably interpolating focal length or tangent-half-angle for perceptually stable motion. Define all tuning against either vertical or horizontal FOV consistently and clamp accessibility-sensitive extremes.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入動態視野角：探索時垂直 FOV 60°，奔跑速度由 4 增至 8 m/s 時平滑擴至 72°，0.3 秒追上、0.5 秒返回；瞄準時改為 45°，0.18 秒過渡。鏡頭位置全程不變，設定選單可把奔跑增幅降至 0°。
prompt.en: In your game, add dynamic FOV: use 60° vertical FOV while exploring, widening smoothly to 72° as running speed rises from 4 to 8 m/s, with 0.3 s attack and 0.5 s recovery. Aiming uses 45° over 0.18 s. Keep camera position fixed and let players reduce the sprint increase to 0°.
prompt.ja: ゲームに動的な視野角を追加して。探索時の垂直 FOV は 60°、走行速度が 4 から 8 m/秒へ上がるにつれて 72°まで広げ、追従 0.3 秒、復帰 0.5 秒。照準時は 0.18 秒で 45°にする。カメラ位置は変えず、設定で走行時の増加量を 0°まで下げられるようにする。

CAM-19.params: wide/tele FOV · zoom duration · easing · zoom steps · sensitivity scaling · reticle overlay · projection mode
CAM-19.impl: Change FOV for a perspective camera, or visible size for an orthographic camera, without moving its observation point. Scale look sensitivity with the zoom ratio and keep the same aim ray so entering zoom does not shift the target under the reticle.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入望遠鏡變焦：按住瞄準時鏡頭位置不動，垂直 FOV 在 0.22 秒內由 60° 收窄至 24°，放開後 0.3 秒返回；視角靈敏度同步降至 45%，畫面加圓形遮罩。變焦前後準星中央必須仍指向同一個世界點。
prompt.en: In your game, add binocular zoom: while aim is held, keep the camera position fixed and narrow vertical FOV from 60° to 24° over 0.22 s, returning over 0.3 s on release. Reduce look sensitivity to 45%, add a circular mask, and keep the reticle centre on the same world point before and after zoom.
prompt.ja: ゲームに双眼鏡ズームを追加して。照準を押している間はカメラ位置を固定し、垂直 FOV を 0.22 秒で 60°から 24°へ狭め、離したら 0.3 秒で戻す。視点感度は 45% に下げ、円形マスクを付ける。ズーム前後でレティクル中央が同じワールド座標を指すようにする。

CAM-20.params: start/end distance · travel duration · path direction · easing · fixed FOV · collision handling · focus target
CAM-20.impl: Move the camera's world position along its viewing direction or another designed path while holding FOV constant. Continue recomputing orientation toward the subject if required, and collision-test the swept path rather than only the final position.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中做一次推近鏡頭：對話重點出現時，把鏡頭沿視線由角色外 8 m 移至 3.5 m，歷時 1.2 秒並用 ease-in-out；垂直 FOV 固定 55°，全程注視角色眼睛。前景與背景的相對大小要隨位置改變，路徑遇牆則停在牆前 0.15 m。
prompt.en: In your game, add a push-in for a dialogue reveal: move the camera along its view from 8 m to 3.5 m from the character over 1.2 s with ease-in-out, keeping vertical FOV fixed at 55° and looking at the character's eyes. Foreground/background scale relationships must change; stop 0.15 m before any wall on the path.
prompt.ja: ゲームの会話で重要な事実が明かされる時、カメラを視線方向にキャラクターから 8 m の位置から 3.5 m まで、1.2 秒のイーズイン・アウトで押し込んで。垂直 FOV は 55°で固定し、常に目を注視する。前景と背景の相対サイズを変化させ、経路上の壁の 0.15 m 手前で止める。

CAM-21.params: subject distance range · target screen height · FOV range · effect duration · easing · focus tracking · background depth
CAM-21.impl: Animate camera distance and FOV in opposite directions while solving FOV each frame to preserve the subject's projected height. Clamp both values and measure the subject from a stable focus plane so animation or posture changes do not destabilize the effect.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入一次 dolly zoom：角色受驚時，鏡頭在 1.5 秒內由 8 m 推至 3 m，同時自動調整垂直 FOV，令角色一直佔畫面高度 42%；用 ease-in-out，焦點鎖在胸口，FOV 限制 20–75°。背景應明顯伸縮，但角色大小不得漂移超過 2%。
prompt.en: In your game, add a dolly zoom when the character is shocked: move from 8 m to 3 m over 1.5 s while solving vertical FOV so the character remains 42% of screen height. Use ease-in-out, measure at the chest, clamp FOV to 20–75°, and keep subject-size drift below 2% while the background visibly stretches.
prompt.ja: ゲームでキャラクターが衝撃を受けた時にドリーズームを入れて。1.5 秒で距離を 8 m から 3 m へ近づけながら垂直 FOV を調整し、キャラクターの高さを常に画面の 42% に保つ。イーズイン・アウト、胸を基準、FOV は 20〜75°。背景は大きく伸縮させ、被写体サイズのずれは 2% 未満にする。

CAM-22.params: subject thirds point · horizon line · look-room side · safe margin · anchor smoothing · composition override
CAM-22.impl: Express composition anchors in normalized viewport coordinates, then solve camera position or aim so selected subjects land near those anchors. Treat thirds as a tunable guide and allow gameplay constraints or central compositions to override it.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中使用三分構圖：探索時把角色頭部放在左側三分線與上方三分線附近，即畫面座標 (0.33, 0.33)，地平線放在高度 0.66；角色向左移動時把錨點在 0.35 秒內鏡像到 x=0.67，四邊保留 5% 安全距離。
prompt.en: In your game, use thirds-based composition while exploring: place the character's head near viewport (0.33, 0.33) and the horizon at y=0.66. When the character moves left, mirror the anchor to x=0.67 over 0.35 s, preserving a 5% safe margin on every edge.
prompt.ja: ゲームの探索中に三分割構図を使って。キャラクターの頭を画面座標 (0.33, 0.33) 付近、地平線を y=0.66 に置く。左へ移動する時は 0.35 秒でアンカーを x=0.67 へ反転し、四辺に 5% の安全余白を残す。

CAM-23.params: subject screen share · open-space side · clutter density · tonal contrast · safe margin · transition time
CAM-23.impl: Choose an off-centre subject anchor that reserves a controlled portion of the frame for low-detail space, then bias the camera toward that composition. Validate the intended region using scene tags or density/contrast metadata rather than assuming empty geometry automatically reads as negative space.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中為孤獨場景加入留白構圖：把角色放在畫面左側 28% 位置，角色高度只佔畫面 18%，右側至少 55% 範圍只保留低對比天空與遠景；以 0.8 秒由普通跟隨過渡過去。不要把 HUD 放進這片留白，也不要用前視速度改變它。
prompt.en: In your game, compose the lonely scene with negative space: place the character at 28% of screen width and only 18% of screen height, reserving at least 55% on the right for low-contrast sky and distant scenery. Transition from normal follow over 0.8 s; keep HUD out of that space and do not drive it from velocity look-ahead.
prompt.ja: ゲームの孤独な場面で余白を作って。キャラクターを画面幅 28% の位置に置き、高さは画面の 18% だけにする。右側の少なくとも 55% は低コントラストの空と遠景にし、通常追従から 0.8 秒で移行する。この余白に HUD を置かず、速度先読みでも動かさない。

CAM-24.params: shot duration · framing scale · reveal path · hold time · transition out · control lock · skip behaviour
CAM-24.impl: Author an opening camera state or short path that establishes location and scale, then hand control back to the gameplay camera through a cut or blend. Keep the sequence state-driven so it can be skipped cleanly without leaving camera or input state half-applied.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入 Boss 場地交代鏡頭：進場先用 3.2 秒廣角展示整個 60 m 闊競技場，Boss 與角色同框並各佔畫面高度約 12%；首 0.6 秒停住，之後慢慢推向入口，最後 0.5 秒交接回玩法鏡頭。玩家可按鍵跳過，跳過後立即恢復操作。
prompt.en: In your game, add an establishing shot for the boss arena: spend 3.2 s showing the full 60 m-wide space, with boss and player both in frame at roughly 12% of screen height. Hold for 0.6 s, then drift toward the entrance and blend to gameplay over the final 0.5 s. Allow skipping with immediate control restoration.
prompt.ja: ゲームにボス闘技場の導入ショットを追加して。3.2 秒で幅 60 m の会場全体を見せ、ボスとプレイヤーを同じ画面に入れて各々の高さを約 12% にする。最初の 0.6 秒は静止し、その後入口へゆっくり寄り、最後の 0.5 秒でプレイ用カメラへ遷移する。スキップ時は即座に操作を戻す。

CAM-25.params: subject screen coverage · framing target · camera distance/FOV · entry duration · hold time · exit transition · headroom
CAM-25.impl: Define the close-up by projected subject coverage and framing anchor, then solve distance or FOV according to scene constraints. Keep depth of field and focal length as independent artistic choices rather than implicitly enabling them with the shot scale.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入道具特寫：玩家取得鑰匙後，在 0.3 秒內切至手部構圖，鑰匙佔畫面高度 62%，中心位於 (0.5, 0.46)；保持 1.1 秒，再用 0.4 秒返回玩法鏡頭。背景景深維持原設定，不要因為特寫而自動加模糊。
prompt.en: In your game, add a close-up when the player obtains the key: transition to the hand over 0.3 s, framing the key at 62% of screen height and viewport (0.5, 0.46). Hold for 1.1 s, then return to gameplay over 0.4 s. Preserve the existing depth-of-field settings instead of adding blur automatically.
prompt.ja: ゲームで鍵を入手した時に手元のクローズアップを入れて。0.3 秒で切り替え、鍵を画面高さの 62%、画面座標 (0.5, 0.46) に配置する。1.1 秒保持し、0.4 秒でプレイ用カメラへ戻す。クローズアップだからといって背景ぼけを自動追加せず、既存の被写界深度設定を保つ。

CAM-26.params: roll angle · entry time · hold time · recovery time · roll direction · maximum angle · motion-reduction scale
CAM-26.impl: Apply roll around the camera's forward axis after aim orientation is solved, then interpolate with a bounded easing curve. Expose an accessibility multiplier because sustained or oscillating roll can cause discomfort.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入斜水平鏡頭：角色進入幻覺區時，在 0.25 秒內把鏡頭沿視軸翻滾至 12°，維持最多 2 秒，再用 0.8 秒回到 0°；不要改變 pitch 或 yaw。設定中的「減少鏡頭動態」可把角度縮至 3° 或完全關閉。
prompt.en: In your game, add a Dutch angle in the hallucination zone: roll the camera 12° around its view axis over 0.25 s, hold for at most 2 s, then recover to 0° over 0.8 s without changing pitch or yaw. A reduced-camera-motion option must lower it to 3° or disable it.
prompt.ja: ゲームの幻覚エリアでダッチアングルを使って。視軸まわりに 0.25 秒で 12° ロールし、最大 2 秒保持してから 0.8 秒で 0°へ戻す。pitch と yaw は変えない。「カメラ動作を減らす」設定では 3°まで弱めるか無効にできるようにする。

CAM-27.params: spline control points · progress driver · travel duration · speed curve · look target · path offset · banking · player influence
CAM-27.impl: Evaluate position on a spline by normalized arc length so speed remains consistent despite uneven control-point spacing. Drive progress from time or projected player position, evaluate orientation separately from a look target, and collision-test any optional player-controlled offset.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入沿預設路線運鏡：鏡頭沿 6 個控制點的曲線穿過山谷，全程 8 秒；按弧長重參數化，令基本速度均勻，首尾各用 0.7 秒加減速。鏡頭一直望向角色前方 4 m，玩家可用右搖桿在軌道兩側偏移最多 0.6 m，但不可離開路線。
prompt.en: In your game, move the camera along a six-control-point route through the valley over 8 s. Reparameterize by arc length for constant base speed, easing in and out over 0.7 s at each end. Look 4 m ahead of the character and allow up to 0.6 m of right-stick offset beside the rail without leaving it.
prompt.ja: ゲームで谷を通る 6 制御点の経路に沿ってカメラを 8 秒で移動させて。弧長で再パラメータ化して基本速度を一定にし、開始と終了は各 0.7 秒で加減速する。キャラクターの 4 m 前方を注視し、右スティックでレール横に最大 0.6 m だけずらせるが、経路からは外れないようにする。

CAM-28.params: focus distance · focus range · blur strength · near transition · far transition · maximum blur radius · quality tier
CAM-28.impl: Use the depth buffer to estimate each pixel's distance from the focus plane, derive a signed circle-of-confusion value, and blur near and far samples separately before compositing. Keep HUD and other screen-space overlays outside the depth-of-field pass.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入景深：對話時把焦點距離設在角色眼睛，清晰範圍前後各 0.5 m；距離焦點超過 4 m 的背景逐步加至最大 8 px 模糊，鏡頭前 0.8 m 內的前景最高 5 px。焦點用 0.2 秒平滑更新，HUD 必須保持完全清晰。
prompt.en: In your game, add depth of field during dialogue: focus on the character's eyes with a ±0.5 m sharp range. Ramp background blur to a maximum 8 px beyond 4 m from focus, and near-foreground blur to 5 px within 0.8 m of the camera. Smooth focus distance over 0.2 s and keep the HUD perfectly sharp.
prompt.ja: ゲームの会話中に被写界深度を追加して。キャラクターの目へピントを合わせ、前後 ±0.5 m を鮮明にする。焦点から 4 m 以上離れた背景は最大 8 px、カメラから 0.8 m 以内の前景は最大 5 px まで徐々にぼかす。焦点距離は 0.2 秒で平滑化し、HUD は常に鮮明に保つ。

CAM-29.params: start/end focus distance · pull duration · easing · hold time · aperture/blur strength · focus target tracking
CAM-29.impl: Animate only the focus distance between measured subject depths while keeping camera transform and FOV unchanged. Feed the animated value into the depth-of-field calculation, and use stable target anchors to avoid focus jitter from deforming meshes.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入移焦：鏡頭保持完全不動，先對準 2.2 m 外的前景角色；背景門在 11 m 外打開時，用 0.8 秒 ease-in-out 把焦點距離移至 11 m，前景由清變糊、門由糊變清，並保持 1.2 秒。FOV 與鏡頭位置全程不得改變。
prompt.en: In your game, add a rack focus with the camera completely still: begin focused on the foreground character at 2.2 m, then when the door at 11 m opens, pull focus to 11 m over 0.8 s with ease-in-out and hold for 1.2 s. The character should blur as the door sharpens; do not change FOV or camera transform.
prompt.ja: ゲームにラックフォーカスを追加して。カメラは完全に固定し、最初は 2.2 m の手前のキャラクターにピントを合わせる。11 m 先の扉が開いたら、0.8 秒のイーズイン・アウトで焦点距離を 11 m へ移し、1.2 秒保持する。手前はぼけ、扉は鮮明になるが、FOV とカメラ位置は変えない。

CAM-30.params: translation amplitude · rotation amplitude · duration · frequency · noise seed · envelope · distance falloff · motion-reduction scale
CAM-30.impl: Generate deterministic band-limited noise for positional and rotational offsets, multiply it by an attack-decay envelope, and add it after normal camera following. Combine simultaneous impulses through a bounded intensity value and attenuate them by event distance and direction.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入鏡頭震動：近距離重擊觸發 0.22 秒震動，畫面平移最高 ±6 px、翻滾最高 ±1.2°、頻率約 24 Hz；首 0.03 秒快速增強，之後指數衰減。距離每增加 5 m 強度減半，20 m 外不觸發；「減少鏡頭動態」把強度降至 25%。
prompt.en: In your game, add camera shake for a nearby heavy hit: 0.22 s duration, up to ±6 px translation, ±1.2° roll, and roughly 24 Hz noise, with a 0.03 s attack followed by exponential decay. Halve strength every 5 m and stop beyond 20 m; reduced camera motion scales intensity to 25%.
prompt.ja: ゲームで近距離の強打にカメラシェイクを追加して。時間は 0.22 秒、平行移動は最大 ±6 px、ロールは ±1.2°、周波数は約 24 Hz。最初の 0.03 秒で立ち上げ、その後は指数的に減衰する。距離 5 m ごとに半減し、20 m 以上では発生させず、動作軽減設定では強度を 25% にする。

CAM-31.params: cut trigger · source/destination state · one-frame switch · input continuity · audio continuity · post-cut hold · orientation check
CAM-31.impl: Replace the active camera state between rendered frames without interpolating position, rotation, or lens values. Update dependent visibility and audio-listener state atomically, and preserve or deliberately remap player input so the cut does not masquerade as a control reversal.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入直接切鏡：Boss 登場時，上一幀仍是角色背後鏡頭，下一幀立即切到 Boss 正面近鏡，完全不插值亦不淡化；保持 0.9 秒後再切回。兩個機位的畫面方向差不要超過 150°，切換同一幀更新可見性與音訊監聽位置。
prompt.en: In your game, add a hard cut for the boss entrance: one frame is the camera behind the character and the next is a frontal close view of the boss, with no interpolation or fade. Hold for 0.9 s, then cut back; keep the shot directions within 150° and update visibility and the audio listener on the same frame.
prompt.ja: ゲームのボス登場にハードカットを追加して。前のフレームはキャラクター背後、次のフレームはボス正面の寄りへ、補間もフェードもなく即座に切り替える。0.9 秒保持してから戻し、2 つのショット方向の差は 150°以内、可視判定と音声リスナーも同じフレームで更新する。

CAM-32.params: blend duration · position curve · rotation interpolation · lens interpolation · target handoff · collision checks · interruption policy
CAM-32.impl: Interpolate one complete camera state into another: position along a chosen curve, orientation on the shortest rotation arc, and projection parameters in a perceptually suitable space. Evaluate collision and target visibility on intermediate states, and define whether a new request restarts from the current blended state or queues.

prompt.zh: 在遊戲中加入平滑鏡頭交接：由探索鏡頭轉至對話構圖需 0.75 秒，位置用 cubic ease-in-out，旋轉走最短弧，垂直 FOV 由 60° 平滑變至 42°；每幀檢查中間位置是否穿牆。若期間再觸發新鏡頭，便以當前混合狀態作新起點，不要跳回舊鏡頭。
prompt.en: In your game, blend from exploration to dialogue framing over 0.75 s: use cubic ease-in-out for position, the shortest rotation arc, and smoothly change vertical FOV from 60° to 42°. Test every intermediate position for walls; if another camera request arrives, start the new blend from the current blended state rather than snapping back.
prompt.ja: ゲームで探索カメラから会話構図へ 0.75 秒で滑らかに引き継いで。位置は cubic ease-in-out、回転は最短弧、垂直 FOV は 60°から 42°へ滑らかに変える。途中位置は毎フレーム壁との衝突を調べ、新しい要求が来たら現在の混合状態を始点にして、元のカメラへ戻さない。

REN-01.params: base color · metallic · roughness · normal strength · environment intensity · exposure
REN-01.impl: Use an energy-aware surface model with a documented material workflow, consistent texture ranges, and calibrated lighting. Validate representative metal, dielectric, and stone assets under several environments rather than tuning them for one shot.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入按物理規律反應的材質：同一測試場景放置金屬、塑膠及石材球各 1 個，metallic 設為 1、0、0，roughness 設為 0.2、0.35、0.8，並在日光與室內燈光下保持材質可辨。
prompt.en: In your game, add physically based materials: place one metal, plastic, and stone sphere in the same test scene, set metallic to 1, 0, and 0 and roughness to 0.2, 0.35, and 0.8, then keep each material recognizable under daylight and indoor lighting.
prompt.ja: ゲームに物理ベースのマテリアルを追加してください。同じテストシーンに金属・プラスチック・石の球を1個ずつ置き、metallicを1・0・0、roughnessを0.2・0.35・0.8に設定し、昼光と室内照明の両方で材質を判別できるようにします。

REN-02.params: tint · texture · opacity · emission value · depth mode · tone-map bypass
REN-02.impl: Render the surface from its texture and tint without evaluating scene lights. Decide explicitly whether exposure, tone mapping, fog, and depth testing still affect the result.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入不受場景燈光影響的平色材質：把任務圖示設為 unlit、色值 #4DE1FF，讓它進入全黑陰影後仍保持同色，尺寸固定為畫面高度的 4%。
prompt.en: In your game, add an unlit flat-color material: render the quest icon in #4DE1FF, keep the same color in fully dark shadow, and hold its size at 4% of screen height.
prompt.ja: ゲームにシーン照明の影響を受けないフラットカラー材質を追加してください。クエストアイコンを#4DE1FFで描画し、完全な影の中でも同じ色を保ち、画面高の4%の大きさに固定します。

REN-03.params: band count · ramp colors · shadow threshold · softness · specular size · ambient fill
REN-03.impl: Map a lighting term through an artist-authored ramp or a small set of thresholds, with separate controls for shadow and highlight bands. Keep face or hero-character overrides available where raw normals produce unwanted bands.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入動畫式分層明暗：角色使用 3 級色帶，暗面門檻 0.35、亮面門檻 0.7、過渡寬度 0.02，並把高光限制為一塊硬邊亮色。
prompt.en: In your game, add toon shading: use three lighting bands on the character with thresholds at 0.35 and 0.7, a transition width of 0.02, and one hard-edged highlight patch.
prompt.ja: ゲームにアニメ風の段階的な陰影を追加してください。キャラクターを3段階にし、しきい値を0.35と0.7、遷移幅を0.02に設定して、ハイライトは硬い縁の1色面にします。

REN-04.params: line width · line color · depth threshold · normal threshold · distance scaling · object mask
REN-04.impl: Generate contours from an expanded shell or from depth, normal, and object-ID discontinuities. Stabilize width in screen space and exclude small interior edges that would clutter the image.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入物件輪廓線：玩家角色用 2 px 深藍外框，互動目標用 4 px 黃色外框，距離 5 至 30 米仍維持相同畫面粗幼。
prompt.en: In your game, add object outlines: use a 2 px dark-blue contour for the player and a 4 px yellow contour for interactable targets, keeping the screen-space width stable from 5 to 30 meters.
prompt.ja: ゲームにオブジェクトの輪郭線を追加してください。プレイヤーには2 pxの濃紺、操作対象には4 pxの黄色を使い、距離5〜30 mでも画面上の太さを一定に保ちます。

REN-05.params: rim color · rim power · rim width · light alignment · intensity · occlusion
REN-05.impl: Build a surface-edge mask from the view and normal angle, then optionally constrain it by light direction and occlusion. Apply the result inside the silhouette as a controlled lighting or emissive contribution.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入表面邊緣亮帶：主角使用青色 rim light，寬度約佔輪廓內側 6%，強度 1.8，並只在主光背向角色時提升至 3.0。
prompt.en: In your game, add rim lighting: give the hero a cyan rim covering about 6% inside the silhouette at intensity 1.8, increasing to 3.0 only when the key light is behind the character.
prompt.ja: ゲームにリムライトを追加してください。主人公のシルエット内側約6%をシアンで光らせ、強度を1.8、キーライトが背後にある場合だけ3.0へ上げます。

REN-06.params: F0 · grazing strength · exponent · roughness · tint · view-angle bias
REN-06.impl: Evaluate angle-dependent reflectance from the view-normal relationship, using a physically plausible approximation for reflective materials. Keep any stylized emissive use as a separate, clearly labeled artistic layer.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入菲涅耳反射：水面正視時反射率設為 0.02，掠射角逐步升至接近 1.0，並用 roughness 0.08 保留清晰遠景反射。
prompt.en: In your game, add Fresnel reflectance to water: use 0.02 reflectance head-on, rise gradually toward 1.0 at grazing angles, and set roughness to 0.08 for a clear distant reflection.
prompt.ja: ゲームの水面にフレネル反射を追加してください。正面の反射率を0.02、浅い角度では徐々に1.0近くまで上げ、roughnessを0.08にして遠景の映り込みを鮮明にします。

REN-07.params: base color · texture scale · tint · saturation · value range · vertex color
REN-07.impl: Store the surface's underlying color in a lighting-neutral texture appropriate to the chosen material workflow. Avoid accidental baked highlights and shadows unless they are an intentional part of a hand-painted style.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入材質底色：石牆使用 2 m 一循環的灰褐色貼圖，明度限制於 0.25 至 0.65，並移除貼圖內固定方向的高光與黑色陰影。
prompt.en: In your game, add a base-color map to the stone wall: tile it every 2 meters, keep values between 0.25 and 0.65, and remove highlights or black shadows tied to a fixed light direction.
prompt.ja: ゲームの石壁にベースカラーマップを追加してください。2 mごとに繰り返し、明度を0.25〜0.65に収め、固定方向の光によるハイライトや黒い影は除きます。

REN-08.params: roughness · smoothness · map contrast · minimum value · maximum value · mip filtering
REN-08.impl: Drive reflection spread with a perceptually useful roughness or smoothness signal and document its direction and encoding. Filter high-frequency variation to prevent distant highlights from sparkling.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入粗滑度變化：同一石地的乾位 roughness 設為 0.78，濕位設為 0.18，以 0.5 m 漸變區連接，保持底色亮度不變。
prompt.en: In your game, add roughness variation to one stone floor: set dry areas to 0.78 and wet areas to 0.18, blend them over 0.5 meters, and keep base-color brightness unchanged.
prompt.ja: ゲームの同じ石床に粗さの変化を追加してください。乾いた部分をroughness 0.78、濡れた部分を0.18にし、0.5 mの範囲でつなぎ、ベースカラーの明るさは変えません。

REN-09.params: metallic · base color · roughness · mask threshold · edge blend · environment intensity
REN-09.impl: Use a metallic mask to separate exposed conductive material from dielectric coatings such as paint or dirt. Supply meaningful surroundings to reflect and preserve roughness as an independent property.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入金屬性遮罩：機械人的裸鋼區 metallic 設為 1、藍色漆面設為 0、磨損邊緣以 3 mm 遮罩露出金屬，兩者 roughness 同為 0.35。
prompt.en: In your game, add a metallic mask: set the robot's bare steel to 1 and blue paint to 0, reveal metal with a 3 mm wear mask along edges, and keep both regions at roughness 0.35.
prompt.ja: ゲームに金属性マスクを追加してください。ロボットの露出した鋼を1、青い塗装を0にし、縁の3 mm幅の摩耗マスクで金属を見せ、両方のroughnessは0.35に保ちます。

REN-10.params: specular intensity · roughness · light size · highlight tint · shape · view response
REN-10.impl: Compute highlights from the light, view, surface normal, and micro-surface parameters. For stylized art, quantize or reshape the highlight after preserving its angle-dependent movement.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入光源高光：角色眼球各顯示 1 個直徑約 6 px 的白色亮點，roughness 設為 0.12，轉動鏡頭 45° 時亮點須沿球面移動。
prompt.en: In your game, add specular highlights: show one white spot about 6 px wide on each eye at roughness 0.12, and make the spots move across the curved surface when the camera rotates 45 degrees.
prompt.ja: ゲームにスペキュラハイライトを追加してください。各眼球に直径約6 pxの白い光点を1つ出し、roughnessを0.12に設定して、カメラを45度回したとき球面上を移動させます。

REN-11.params: anisotropy · tangent direction · roughness · rotation · highlight stretch · map strength
REN-11.impl: Use tangent-oriented micro-surface response so highlights stretch along a controlled direction. Ensure meshes and direction maps have stable tangent data, especially across UV seams.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入方向性反光：拉絲鋁面 anisotropy 設為 0.75、roughness 0.3，拉絲方向沿水平切線，旋轉物件 90° 時拉長高光亦跟着轉向。
prompt.en: In your game, add anisotropic reflection to brushed aluminum: set anisotropy to 0.75 and roughness to 0.3, align brushing with the horizontal tangent, and rotate the stretched highlight when the object turns 90 degrees.
prompt.ja: ゲームのヘアライン加工アルミに異方性反射を追加してください。anisotropyを0.75、roughnessを0.3にし、加工方向を水平接線に合わせ、物体を90度回すと伸びたハイライトも回転させます。

REN-12.params: emission color · intensity · mask · pulse rate · GI contribution · exposure response
REN-12.impl: Add radiance from an emissive mask independently of direct illumination. If nearby surfaces must receive light, feed emission into an indirect-lighting solution or pair it with an explicit light source.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入自發光表面：機械眼用 #FF3B2F、強度 8，暗房中仍可見；另加半徑 1.5 m 的紅光照亮附近牆身，但關閉 bloom 後眼睛仍保持明亮。
prompt.en: In your game, add an emissive surface: render the mechanical eye in #FF3B2F at intensity 8 so it remains visible in darkness, and add a separate red light with a 1.5 m radius for the wall; the eye must stay bright with bloom disabled.
prompt.ja: ゲームに発光面を追加してください。メカの目を#FF3B2F、強度8で暗闇でも見えるようにし、壁を照らす半径1.5 mの赤いライトを別に置きます。bloomを切っても目の明るさは保ちます。

REN-13.params: normal strength · tangent convention · texture scale · mip bias · detail blend · channel orientation
REN-13.impl: Perturb shading normals with a correctly decoded normal or height map while leaving mesh positions unchanged. Match tangent basis and channel orientation across asset creation and rendering.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入法線貼圖：平坦磚牆以每塊磚 20 cm 的比例顯示 8 mm 深磚縫，normal strength 設為 0.8，移動燈光時凹凸明暗要轉變但牆身剪影不變。
prompt.en: In your game, add normal mapping to a flat brick wall: use 20 cm bricks with apparent 8 mm mortar depth at strength 0.8, changing relief shading as the light moves while leaving the wall silhouette unchanged.
prompt.ja: ゲームの平らなレンガ壁にノーマルマッピングを追加してください。レンガを20 cm、目地の見かけの深さを8 mm、strengthを0.8にし、光を動かすと凹凸の陰影だけが変わり、壁のシルエットは変えません。

REN-14.params: height scale · step count · refinement steps · view-angle fade · self-shadow · UV scale
REN-14.impl: Offset texture sampling by tracing through a height field along the view direction, with bounded iteration and refinement counts. Fade or simplify the effect at grazing angles and distance to control stretching and cost.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入 POM 假深坑：石地高度設為 3 cm，使用 24 個基本步驟加 4 次細化，視角低於表面 12° 時逐步淡出，斜看時近處石塊可遮住後方紋理。
prompt.en: In your game, add POM recesses to a stone floor: use a 3 cm height range, 24 primary steps plus 4 refinement steps, fade below a 12-degree surface angle, and let nearer stones occlude texture details behind them at oblique views.
prompt.ja: ゲームの石床にPOMの疑似的なくぼみを追加してください。高さ範囲を3 cm、基本24ステップと細分化4回にし、表面に対する角度が12度未満ではフェードさせ、斜めから見た近い石が奥の模様を隠すようにします。

REN-15.params: displacement scale · mesh density · frequency · direction · bounds padding · shadow sync
REN-15.impl: Move actual vertices along a chosen direction using a height or procedural signal, and provide enough geometry for the target detail scale. Update culling bounds and all required shadow or collision representations deliberately.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入頂點位移：水面網格每米至少 16 格，沿法線產生振幅 0.25 m、波長 4 m、速度 1.2 m/s 的波浪，剪影與投影都要同步改變。
prompt.en: In your game, add vertex displacement to water: use at least 16 grid divisions per meter and normal-direction waves with 0.25 m amplitude, 4 m wavelength, and 1.2 m/s speed, updating both silhouette and cast shadow.
prompt.ja: ゲームの水面に頂点変位を追加してください。1 mあたり16分割以上の格子を使い、法線方向に振幅0.25 m、波長4 m、速度1.2 m/sの波を作り、シルエットと投影を同期して変化させます。

REN-16.params: opacity · blend mode · depth write · sort priority · refraction amount · overdraw limit
REN-16.impl: Composite translucent surfaces with a defined straight- or premultiplied-alpha convention and a deliberate depth/sorting policy. Budget overlapping layers and handle shadows and reflections according to the chosen pipeline.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入半透明幽靈：主體 opacity 設為 0.45、邊緣升至 0.7，採用預乘 alpha，最多容許 4 層重疊，從前後兩個視角都不可出現明顯排序跳動。
prompt.en: In your game, add a translucent ghost: use opacity 0.45 in the body and 0.7 at the rim with premultiplied alpha, allow up to four overlapping layers, and avoid obvious sorting pops from front and rear views.
prompt.ja: ゲームに半透明の幽霊を追加してください。胴体のopacityを0.45、縁を0.7にしてプリマルチプライドalphaを使い、最大4層の重なりでも前後の視点から目立つ描画順の跳びが出ないようにします。

REN-17.params: alpha threshold · edge softness · dither scale · alpha-to-coverage · mip level · shadow cutoff
REN-17.impl: Discard samples below a mask threshold for hard cutouts, using filtered masks and coverage or dithering when needed. Keep cutout behavior consistent in depth and shadow passes.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入剪洞透明：樹葉 alpha threshold 設為 0.5，4× MSAA 時啟用 alpha-to-coverage，20 米外改用 4 px 藍噪聲漸變，葉片洞口與投影形狀要一致。
prompt.en: In your game, add alpha-clipped foliage: use a 0.5 threshold, enable alpha-to-coverage with 4x MSAA, switch to a 4 px blue-noise fade beyond 20 meters, and keep leaf holes consistent in the shadow.
prompt.ja: ゲームにアルファクリップの葉を追加してください。しきい値を0.5、4× MSAA時はalpha-to-coverageを有効にし、20 m以遠では4 pxのブルーノイズフェードへ切り替え、葉の穴と影の形を一致させます。

REN-18.params: index of refraction · distortion scale · thickness · normal strength · chromatic split · edge fade
REN-18.impl: Distort transmitted scene color from surface orientation, thickness, and material refraction parameters. For screen-space implementations, fade invalid or off-screen samples and provide a stable fallback.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入玻璃折射：厚度設為 8 mm、折射率 1.5、擾動最大 12 px，畫面邊緣 20 px 內逐步淡回原背景，不能把折射誤當倒影。
prompt.en: In your game, add glass refraction: use 8 mm thickness, index of refraction 1.5, and at most 12 px distortion, fading back to the undistorted background within 20 px of the screen edge.
prompt.ja: ゲームにガラスの屈折を追加してください。厚さ8 mm、屈折率1.5、ゆがみ最大12 pxとし、画面端から20 px以内では元の背景へ徐々に戻します。屈折を反射として扱わないでください。

REN-19.params: scatter color · scatter radius · thickness · transmission · scale · profile strength
REN-19.impl: Diffuse lighting beneath the surface with a material-specific scattering profile and scale-aware radius. Use thickness or transmission data for backlit thin regions and prevent cross-object bleeding.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入皮下散射：角色皮膚散射半徑設為 1.2 mm、紅色通道強度為藍色的 2.5 倍，耳朵厚度低於 3 mm 時在背光下出現柔和紅光，但不可滲到眼睛。
prompt.en: In your game, add subsurface scattering to skin: use a 1.2 mm scatter radius with red strength 2.5 times blue, make ears thinner than 3 mm glow softly under backlight, and prevent the blur from bleeding into the eyes.
prompt.ja: ゲームの肌にサブサーフェススキャタリングを追加してください。散乱半径を1.2 mm、赤の強度を青の2.5倍にし、厚さ3 mm未満の耳は逆光で柔らかく赤く光らせますが、目にはにじませません。

REN-20.params: bounce count · indirect intensity · update rate · probe spacing · color bleed · denoise radius
REN-20.impl: Capture or solve indirect diffuse and specular transport with a method suited to scene motion and scale. Blend spatial data smoothly, limit leaks, and keep direct lighting independently controllable.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入全域光照：小房間至少計算 1 次反彈，間接光強度 0.8，紅牆令 0.5 米內白箱出現約 10% 紅色染光，移動門後 0.3 秒內更新。
prompt.en: In your game, add global illumination: compute at least one bounce in the small room at indirect intensity 0.8, tint a white box within 0.5 meters of a red wall by about 10%, and update within 0.3 seconds after a door moves.
prompt.ja: ゲームにグローバルイルミネーションを追加してください。小部屋で最低1回の反射、間接光強度0.8とし、赤い壁から0.5 m以内の白い箱に約10%の赤い色移りを出し、扉が動いてから0.3秒以内に更新します。

REN-21.params: occlusion strength · radius · distance · bent normal · direct-light influence · map resolution
REN-21.impl: Represent the fraction of surrounding ambient illumination blocked by nearby geometry, from baked data or a runtime estimate. Apply it chiefly to indirect/environment lighting so direct illumination does not become dirty or double-darkened.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入環境遮蔽：牆角及箱底 10 cm 範圍內逐步加深，strength 設為 0.65，只影響間接光；正午直射光下不可把接觸位塗成純黑。
prompt.en: In your game, add ambient occlusion: darken gradually within 10 cm of corners and crate contacts at strength 0.65, affect indirect light only, and never turn contacts pure black under direct noon light.
prompt.ja: ゲームにアンビエントオクルージョンを追加してください。壁の角や箱の接地点から10 cm以内をstrength 0.65で徐々に暗くし、間接光だけに作用させ、真昼の直射光では接触部を真っ黒にしません。

REN-22.params: sample radius · sample count · depth bias · normal weight · intensity · denoise radius
REN-22.impl: Estimate local visibility from screen depth and normals with a bounded sampling radius, then edge-aware filter the result. Reject depth discontinuities and accept that off-screen or hidden geometry is unavailable.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入 SSAO：以 0.6 米半徑、16 個樣本、0.02 米 depth bias 計算，強度 0.7，再用 5 px 深度感知濾波；角色離開畫面時不可留下固定暗印。
prompt.en: In your game, add SSAO: use a 0.6 m radius, 16 samples, 0.02 m depth bias, intensity 0.7, and a 5 px depth-aware filter; do not leave a fixed dark mark after the character exits the frame.
prompt.ja: ゲームにSSAOを追加してください。半径0.6 m、16サンプル、depth bias 0.02 m、強度0.7で計算し、5 pxの深度対応フィルターを使います。キャラクターが画面外へ出た後に暗い跡を残しません。

REN-23.params: probe spacing · capture resolution · influence volume · roughness mip · blend distance · intensity
REN-23.impl: Sample environmental radiance from reflection captures or an image-based-lighting source, selecting and blending data by position. Prefilter the source by roughness and provide parallax correction where nearby geometry makes the approximation obvious.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入環境反射：每個房間放置 1 個 256 px reflection probe，門口用 2 米範圍混合兩邊資料，金屬球 roughness 0.1 時反射清楚、0.8 時變朦。
prompt.en: In your game, add environment reflections: place one 256 px reflection probe per room, blend both probes across 2 meters at each doorway, and make a metal sphere reflect sharply at roughness 0.1 and diffusely at 0.8.
prompt.ja: ゲームに環境反射を追加してください。各部屋に256 pxのreflection probeを1つ置き、出入口の2 m範囲で両方をブレンドし、金属球はroughness 0.1で鮮明、0.8でぼけた映り込みにします。

REN-24.params: ray steps · maximum distance · thickness · stride · edge fade · history weight
REN-24.impl: March reflection rays through screen depth, validate intersections with a thickness tolerance, and temporally stabilize accepted samples. Fade near screen boundaries and blend missing rays into probes or another reflection source.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入 SSR：濕地反射使用最多 48 步、最遠 20 米、厚度容差 0.15 米，畫面邊緣 8% 內淡出，缺失位置回退至 reflection probe。
prompt.en: In your game, add screen-space reflections to wet ground: use up to 48 steps, a 20 m maximum distance, 0.15 m thickness tolerance, fade within the outer 8% of the screen, and fall back to a reflection probe for missing data.
prompt.ja: ゲームの濡れた地面にSSRを追加してください。最大48ステップ、距離20 m、厚み許容0.15 mとし、画面外周8%でフェードし、情報がない部分はreflection probeへフォールバックします。

REN-25.params: light size · shadow resolution · filter radius · depth bias · normal bias · cascade distance
REN-25.impl: Project occluders into a shadow representation and filter visibility in a way that reflects the apparent light size. Tune bias by world scale, preserve contact, and allocate resolution according to camera importance.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入柔邊投影：直徑 0.5 米的面光源令角色腳邊半影約 2 cm、離地 3 米的物件半影約 20 cm，shadow bias 以不出 acne 且影不離地為準。
prompt.en: In your game, add soft cast shadows from a 0.5 m area light: target about 2 cm penumbra at the character's feet and 20 cm for an object 3 meters above the ground, tuning bias to avoid both acne and detached shadows.
prompt.ja: ゲームに柔らかい投影を追加してください。直径0.5 mの面光源で、足元の半影を約2 cm、地面から3 m上の物体の半影を約20 cmにし、acneと影の浮きの両方が出ないようbiasを調整します。

REN-26.params: fog color · start distance · end distance · density · height falloff · sky blend
REN-26.impl: Blend scene radiance toward an atmospheric color as a function of view distance and optionally world height. Define how sky, transparent surfaces, and post-processing participate so layers remain consistent.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入距離霧：由 40 米開始，120 米達到 90% 霧量，霧色 #A9BCC8；天空及透明粒子須用相同霧色，10 米內角色不受影響。
prompt.en: In your game, add distance fog: begin at 40 meters, reach 90% fog by 120 meters, and use #A9BCC8; apply the same fog color to sky and transparent particles while leaving characters within 10 meters unaffected.
prompt.ja: ゲームに距離フォグを追加してください。40 mから始め、120 mで90%に達し、色は#A9BCC8にします。空と透明パーティクルにも同じ色を適用し、10 m以内のキャラクターには影響させません。

REN-27.params: density · scattering · absorption · anisotropy · volume resolution · temporal weight
REN-27.impl: Integrate light scattering and extinction through a participating medium, including shadowed regions along each view path. Use jittered low-resolution sampling and guarded temporal accumulation to balance cost and stability.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入體積光：教堂窗外陽光穿過密度 0.04 的薄霧，scattering anisotropy 設為 0.6，以每條光線 64 步取樣，門柱遮擋後形成 3 條清楚但柔邊的光柱。
prompt.en: In your game, add volumetric lighting: send sunlight through church windows into fog of density 0.04, use scattering anisotropy 0.6 and 64 samples per ray, and form three distinct soft-edged beams behind the pillars.
prompt.ja: ゲームにボリューメトリックライトを追加してください。教会の窓から密度0.04の霧へ日光を通し、散乱のanisotropyを0.6、1本あたり64サンプルにして、柱の遮蔽で3本の明瞭かつ柔らかい光筋を作ります。

REN-28.params: buffer range · white point · exposure · highlight threshold · precision · output mode
REN-28.impl: Accumulate scene lighting in a format that preserves values well above display white, then apply exposure and display mapping later. Keep internal HDR rendering distinct from the final SDR or HDR display encoding.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入 HDR 渲染流程：場景緩衝保留至少 0 至 16 的線性亮度，窗外日光峰值設為 12、室內燈為 2，調低曝光 2 stops 後兩者仍有層次。
prompt.en: In your game, add an HDR rendering pipeline: preserve at least 0 to 16 linear scene brightness, set exterior sunlight peaks to 12 and interior lamps to 2, and retain gradation in both after reducing exposure by 2 stops.
prompt.ja: ゲームにHDRレンダリングを追加してください。シーンバッファで少なくとも0〜16の線形輝度を保持し、屋外の日光ピークを12、室内灯を2に設定して、露出を2 stops下げても両方の階調を残します。

REN-29.params: threshold · knee · intensity · radius · mip count · tint
REN-29.impl: Extract or weight bright image regions, blur them across several scales, and add the result back conservatively. Keep the source image intact and expose controls that prevent halos from swallowing nearby detail.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入 bloom：亮度門檻設為 1.2、soft knee 0.5、強度 0.35、最大光暈半徑 24 px；強度為 8 的招牌可見柔光，但白色 UI 不可觸發。
prompt.en: In your game, add bloom: use threshold 1.2, soft knee 0.5, intensity 0.35, and a maximum 24 px halo radius; an emissive sign at intensity 8 should glow, while white UI must not trigger it.
prompt.ja: ゲームにbloomを追加してください。しきい値1.2、soft knee 0.5、強度0.35、光輪の最大半径24 pxとし、強度8の発光看板は光らせますが、白いUIには反応させません。

REN-30.params: compensation · minimum EV · maximum EV · adaptation up · adaptation down · metering mask
REN-30.impl: Estimate representative scene luminance with robust metering, convert it to a bounded exposure target, and approach that target at separate brightening and darkening rates. Exclude overlays and exceptional pixels from metering where appropriate.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入自動曝光：限制於 EV −2 至 12，由暗轉亮以 3 EV/s 適應、由亮轉暗以 1.5 EV/s 適應，中央 60% 畫面佔主要測光權重，UI 不參與。
prompt.en: In your game, add auto exposure: clamp it from EV -2 to 12, adapt dark-to-bright at 3 EV/s and bright-to-dark at 1.5 EV/s, give the central 60% of the image most metering weight, and exclude UI.
prompt.ja: ゲームに自動露出を追加してください。EV -2〜12に制限し、暗所から明所は3 EV/s、明所から暗所は1.5 EV/sで順応させ、画面中央60%を測光の中心にしてUIは除外します。

REN-31.params: curve · white point · toe · shoulder · contrast · output gamut
REN-31.impl: Map scene-referred HDR values into the target display range with a smooth toe and highlight shoulder. Apply the transform in a documented color pipeline and test hue preservation in saturated highlights.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入電影式 tone mapping：白點設為線性值 11.2，高光由 4 開始柔和壓縮，0.18 中灰保持約 45% 顯示亮度，紅色霓虹達 8 時不可突然變純白。
prompt.en: In your game, add filmic tone mapping: set the linear white point to 11.2, begin a soft highlight shoulder at 4, map 0.18 middle gray to about 45% display brightness, and keep a red neon value of 8 from abruptly turning white.
prompt.ja: ゲームにフィルミックなトーンマッピングを追加してください。線形白点を11.2、ハイライト圧縮の開始を4、0.18の中間グレーを表示輝度約45%にし、値8の赤いネオンが急に白くならないようにします。

REN-32.params: temperature · tint · saturation · contrast · shadow color · highlight color · LUT strength
REN-32.impl: Apply white balance and creative grading in a known color space at a fixed point in the display pipeline. Blend grades by scene state and verify that neutral references and skin tones remain controllable.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入全畫面調色：雪地白平衡設為 7500 K、飽和度 0.9，陰影加入 8% 藍青、高光加入 4% 暖黃，LUT 強度 0.7，角色膚色偏移不得超過 5%。
prompt.en: In your game, add whole-image color grading: set the snow scene white balance to 7500 K and saturation to 0.9, add 8% cyan-blue to shadows and 4% warm yellow to highlights, use LUT strength 0.7, and keep skin-tone shift below 5%.
prompt.ja: ゲームに画面全体のカラーグレーディングを追加してください。雪原のホワイトバランスを7500 K、彩度を0.9にし、シャドウへ8%の青緑、ハイライトへ4%の暖色を加え、LUT強度0.7で肌色のずれを5%未満にします。

REN-33.params: shutter angle · camera contribution · object velocity · sample count · maximum radius · depth rejection
REN-33.impl: Blur along per-pixel camera and object motion over a simulated shutter interval, rejecting samples across depth discontinuities. Supply correct velocities for skeletal and vertex-deformed geometry and cap the radius for readability.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入速度模糊：以 60 fps、180° shutter 計算，模糊半徑上限 20 px；快速橫移的車身沿速度方向拉開，但車前 1 米的靜止路牌邊緣不可被抹走。
prompt.en: In your game, add motion blur: simulate a 180-degree shutter at 60 fps with a 20 px maximum radius; stretch a fast-moving car along its velocity while preserving the edge of a stationary sign one meter in front of it.
prompt.ja: ゲームにモーションブラーを追加してください。60 fpsで180度シャッター、最大半径20 pxとし、高速移動する車体は速度方向へ伸ばしますが、その1 m手前にある静止標識の縁はにじませません。

REN-34.params: focus distance · aperture · focal length · near blur · far blur · bokeh blades
REN-34.impl: Derive a circle of confusion from camera focus and aperture, then gather or scatter color while respecting foreground/background depth boundaries. Treat transparent and hair-like geometry with an explicit compositing strategy.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入景深：50 mm 鏡頭、f/2.0，焦點距離 4 米；3.5 至 4.5 米的角色保持清楚，12 米外燈點形成直徑約 18 px 的六角散景。
prompt.en: In your game, add depth of field: use a 50 mm lens at f/2.0 focused at 4 meters, keep the character sharp from 3.5 to 4.5 meters, and turn lights beyond 12 meters into roughly 18 px hexagonal bokeh.
prompt.ja: ゲームに被写界深度を追加してください。50 mmレンズ、f/2.0、焦点距離4 mとし、3.5〜4.5 mのキャラクターは鮮明に、12 m以遠の光点は直径約18 pxの六角形ボケにします。

REN-35.params: ghost count · flare intensity · streak length · chromatic tint · occlusion · threshold
REN-35.impl: Generate lens ghosts and streaks from bright, visible light sources or bright image regions using a controlled optical-style layout. Test source occlusion and suppress the effect when the light is behind solid geometry.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入鏡頭耀光：太陽亮度超過 6 時沿畫面中心線產生 5 個光斑及 80 px 光線，總強度 0.3；太陽被建築遮住超過 70% 時在 0.1 秒內淡走。
prompt.en: In your game, add lens flare: when the sun exceeds brightness 6, create five ghosts along the screen-center axis and an 80 px streak at total intensity 0.3; fade it within 0.1 seconds when a building occludes more than 70% of the sun.
prompt.ja: ゲームにレンズフレアを追加してください。太陽の輝度が6を超えたら画面中心軸上に5個のゴーストと80 pxのストリークを合計強度0.3で出し、建物が太陽を70%以上隠したら0.1秒以内に消します。

REN-36.params: radial strength · channel offset · center point · edge falloff · intensity · UI exclusion
REN-36.impl: Offset color channels radially by a small, position-dependent amount, normally increasing toward the image edge. Apply it before UI composition and clamp the displacement to preserve text and gameplay readability.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入色差：畫面中心偏移為 0 px，最外 10% 範圍逐步增至紅藍各 1.5 px；角色受重擊時 0.15 秒內升至 4 px，再於 0.4 秒回復，UI 不受影響。
prompt.en: In your game, add chromatic aberration: use 0 px offset at the center and ramp red/blue separation to 1.5 px in the outer 10%; on a heavy hit, peak at 4 px within 0.15 seconds and recover over 0.4 seconds, excluding UI.
prompt.ja: ゲームに色収差を追加してください。画面中央は0 px、外側10%で赤青のずれを1.5 pxまで増やし、大ダメージ時は0.15秒で4 pxに達して0.4秒で戻します。UIには適用しません。

REN-37.params: render scale · sample rate · texture filtering · roughness floor · LOD bias · temporal stability
REN-37.impl: Diagnose aliasing by separating silhouette, texture, specular, and temporal undersampling. Address each source with appropriate sampling, filtering, level-of-detail, or material bandwidth controls rather than one universal switch.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲檢查及處理走樣：以 1080p、60 fps 沿鐵網橫移鏡頭 10 秒，記錄輪廓鋸齒、幼線閃爍及高光閃點，令每類可見閃爍相對基準減少至少 70%。
prompt.en: In your game, audit and reduce aliasing: at 1080p and 60 fps, pan past a wire fence for 10 seconds, record silhouette jaggies, thin-line shimmer, and specular sparkle separately, and reduce each visible artifact by at least 70% from baseline.
prompt.ja: ゲームのエイリアシングを検査して低減してください。1080p・60 fpsで金網の前を10秒間パンし、輪郭のジャギー、細線のちらつき、ハイライトのきらつきを別々に記録し、各アーティファクトを基準から70%以上減らします。

REN-38.params: sample count · alpha-to-coverage · resolve filter · target format · depth samples · quality level
REN-38.impl: Store multiple coverage and depth samples at geometric edges, then resolve them into the final pixel. Match sample counts across relevant targets and use separate measures for shader or alpha-cutout aliasing.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入 4× MSAA：平滑 1080p 畫面中的模型斜邊，顏色及深度目標均使用 4 個樣本；樹葉另配 alpha-to-coverage，切換前後平均 GPU 時間增幅須記錄。
prompt.en: In your game, add 4x MSAA: smooth mesh diagonals at 1080p with four samples in both color and depth targets, pair foliage with alpha-to-coverage, and record the average GPU-time increase before and after enabling it.
prompt.ja: ゲームに4× MSAAを追加してください。1080pのモデル斜線を滑らかにし、カラーと深度の両ターゲットを4サンプルにします。葉にはalpha-to-coverageも使い、有効化前後の平均GPU時間増加を記録します。

REN-39.params: edge threshold · local contrast · search steps · blend weight · quality preset · sharpness
REN-39.impl: Detect high-contrast edge patterns in the current resolved image and blend across them with bounded neighborhood searches. Run after opaque compositing but before crisp UI, and protect fine texture with contrast thresholds.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入單幀後製抗鋸齒：以 edge threshold 0.1、最多 16 步搜尋處理 1080p 畫面，令欄杆斜邊較順，同時保持 12 px 字體筆劃至少 90% 原有對比。
prompt.en: In your game, add spatial post-process antialiasing: use an edge threshold of 0.1 and up to 16 search steps at 1080p, smooth diagonal railings, and preserve at least 90% of the original stroke contrast in 12 px text.
prompt.ja: ゲームに単一フレームのポストプロセスAAを追加してください。1080pでedge threshold 0.1、最大16探索ステップを使い、斜めの手すりを滑らかにしながら12 px文字の線のコントラストを90%以上保ちます。

REN-40.params: jitter sequence · history weight · velocity scale · rejection threshold · clamp radius · sharpening
REN-40.impl: Jitter subpixel sampling, reproject prior results with motion vectors, reject invalid history, and accumulate only within a stable neighborhood bound. Treat disocclusion, transparency, and animated geometry explicitly before applying restrained sharpening.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入 TAA：使用 8 幀 jitter 序列、靜止 history weight 0.9、移動時降至 0.6，深度差超過 2% 即拒絕歷史，最後加 0.15 銳化；草葉移動不可留下明顯尾影。
prompt.en: In your game, add TAA: use an 8-frame jitter sequence, history weight 0.9 when still and 0.6 in motion, reject history above a 2% depth difference, and apply 0.15 sharpening; moving grass must not leave obvious trails.
prompt.ja: ゲームにTAAを追加してください。8フレームのjitter列、静止時history weight 0.9、移動時0.6を使い、深度差が2%を超えた履歴は棄却し、最後に0.15のシャープ化を加えます。動く草に目立つ尾を残しません。

REN-41.params: motion vectors · history rejection · disocclusion mask · reactive mask · transparency velocity · frame weight
REN-41.impl: Identify which temporal accumulator owns the stale history, then verify motion vectors, disocclusion, and validity masks in that pass. Reject or reduce history around newly revealed pixels and surfaces whose shading changes independently of geometry.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲修正舊影拖尾：讓角色以 8 m/s 橫過高反差牆面，分別關閉 motion blur、TAA／升頻及體積效果作 A/B；修正後尾影須在 2 幀內消失，新露出背景在 3 幀內恢復清晰。
prompt.en: In your game, diagnose and fix temporal ghosting: move a character at 8 m/s across a high-contrast wall and A/B test motion blur, TAA/upscaling, and volumetrics separately; after the fix, trails must disappear within two frames and disoccluded background must recover within three.
prompt.ja: ゲームの時間的ゴーストを診断して修正してください。キャラクターを8 m/sで高コントラストの壁の前を横切らせ、motion blur、TAA／アップスケーリング、ボリューム効果を別々にA/Bします。修正後は尾を2フレーム以内、新たに見えた背景を3フレーム以内に回復させます。

REN-42.params: internal scale · output resolution · jitter · history weight · reactive mask · sharpening · mip bias
REN-42.impl: Reconstruct output pixels from lower-resolution spatial samples and, for temporal methods, reprojected history plus motion data. Adjust texture level-of-detail and reactive masks for transparency, and measure gains only when rendering resolution is the actual bottleneck.

prompt.zh: 在你的遊戲加入升頻：內部以 67% 線性解像度渲染並輸出 2560×1440，時間式重建使用正確 motion vectors、透明 reactive mask 0.8 及銳化 0.2；畫質測試須涵蓋幼線與快速移動邊界。
prompt.en: In your game, add upscaling: render internally at 67% linear resolution and output 2560x1440, using correct motion vectors, a 0.8 transparency reactive mask, and 0.2 sharpening for temporal reconstruction; test thin lines and fast-moving boundaries.
prompt.ja: ゲームにアップスケーリングを追加してください。内部は線形解像度67%で描画し、2560×1440へ出力します。時間再構成には正しいmotion vectors、透明用reactive mask 0.8、シャープ化0.2を使い、細線と高速移動する境界を検証します。

ACT-01.params: grace duration · grounded timestamp · jump eligibility · vertical velocity · edge state
ACT-01.impl: Record the last time the character was grounded and accept a ground jump for a short interval after that time. Consume the eligibility on use so the grace period cannot become an extra aerial jump.

prompt.zh: 加入 100 ms 離地跳躍寬限：角色行出平台邊緣後仍可起跳一次，但用掉後不可在空中再次觸發。
prompt.en: Add a 100 ms ledge grace period: allow one jump after walking off a platform, then consume it so it cannot become a double jump.
prompt.ja: 足場を離れてから100 msだけ地上ジャンプを1回許可し、使用後は空中で再発動できないようにしてください。

ACT-02.params: buffer duration · input timestamp · held requirement · validity check · consume rule
ACT-02.impl: Timestamp a jump press and retain it only for a bounded buffer period. When jumping becomes legal, execute and consume the stored intent; optionally require the button to remain held.

prompt.zh: 加入 120 ms 跳躍輸入緩衝：落地前按住跳掣可在着地首個合法更新自動起跳，放開或逾時即取消。
prompt.en: Add a 120 ms jump buffer: if jump is held shortly before landing, jump on the first valid update after contact; cancel on release or timeout.
prompt.ja: 120 msのジャンプ先行入力を追加し、着地前にボタンを押し続けた場合は着地後最初の有効更新で跳び、離すか時間切れで破棄してください。

ACT-03.params: apex speed threshold · gravity scale · hang duration · jump hold · fall gravity
ACT-03.impl: Detect when vertical speed is near zero and temporarily apply a lower downward acceleration, optionally only while jump is held. Restore normal falling behavior outside the apex band.

prompt.zh: 當垂直速度在 ±0.8 m/s 內且仍按住跳掣時，把重力降至 55%，最多維持 90 ms；離開頂點區即恢復正常。
prompt.en: While vertical speed is within ±0.8 m/s and jump remains held, reduce gravity to 55% for at most 90 ms, then restore normal gravity outside the apex band.
prompt.ja: 垂直速度が±0.8 m/s以内でジャンプを押し続けている間、重力を55%にして最大90 ms維持し、頂点範囲を外れたら通常値へ戻してください。

ACT-04.params: corner probe · lateral nudge · clearance test · ascent only · collision mask
ACT-04.impl: When an ascending character grazes a platform corner, test a few small horizontal offsets toward clearance. Apply the smallest collision-free offset without disabling solid collision.

prompt.zh: 角色上升時若頭頂擦到平台角位，測試左右最多 6 cm 的橫向修正並採用最小可通過位移；完整牆面仍須阻擋。
prompt.en: When the character's head grazes a platform corner while rising, test lateral corrections up to 6 cm and apply the smallest clear offset; full walls must still block movement.
prompt.ja: 上昇中に頭が足場の角へ触れたら左右最大6 cmの補正を試し、通過できる最小量だけずらしてください。壁本体の衝突は無効にしないでください。

ACT-05.params: wall probe distance · surface normal · jump impulse · approach side · use limit
ACT-05.impl: Probe for a valid wall within a small spatial tolerance rather than requiring direct contact. Launch away from the detected surface and consume the wall-jump opportunity according to the movement rules.

prompt.zh: 牆跳容許角色離牆最多 12 cm：偵測最近有效牆面法線，施加離牆方向速度，並限制每次離牆只觸發一次。
prompt.en: Allow wall jumps from up to 12 cm away: use the nearest valid wall normal to launch outward, and permit only one trigger per wall departure.
prompt.ja: 壁から最大12 cm離れていても壁ジャンプを許可し、最寄りの有効な壁法線から外向きに跳ばしてください。壁を離れるたびに1回だけ発動可能にしてください。

ACT-06.params: platform velocity · storage duration · launch contribution · stop timestamp · consume rule
ACT-06.impl: Cache the supporting platform's useful velocity when it stops or contact ends. For a brief period, add that cached contribution to the next jump once, then clear it.

prompt.zh: 升降台停止後保存其最後向上速度 120 ms；期間內起跳可取得 80% 額外上升速度一次，逾時或使用後清除。
prompt.en: Store a lift's last upward velocity for 120 ms after it stops; a jump during that interval receives 80% of the stored boost once, then the value expires.
prompt.ja: 昇降床が停止してから120 msだけ直前の上向き速度を保存し、その間のジャンプへ80%を1回だけ加算して、使用後または時間切れで消去してください。

ACT-07.params: max speed · ground acceleration · braking rate · reversal rate · stop threshold
ACT-07.impl: Move horizontal speed toward a target at separate acceleration, braking, and reversal rates. Keep maximum speed independent from how quickly it is reached or shed.

prompt.zh: 地面移動最高速設為 7 m/s、起步加速度 24 m/s²、放手煞車 36 m/s²、反向加速度 48 m/s²，低於 0.05 m/s 時歸零。
prompt.en: Set ground movement to 7 m/s maximum speed, 24 m/s² acceleration, 36 m/s² release braking, and 48 m/s² reversal, snapping below 0.05 m/s to zero.
prompt.ja: 地上移動を最高7 m/s、加速24 m/s²、入力を離した制動36 m/s²、反転48 m/s²とし、0.05 m/s未満は0へ丸めてください。

ACT-08.params: air acceleration · air max speed · steering multiplier · reversal control · vertical independence
ACT-08.impl: Apply horizontal acceleration from directional input while airborne, capped independently from vertical motion. Tune same-direction steering and reversal separately so air control changes landing position without adding jump height.

prompt.zh: 空中左右輸入使用 9 m/s² 加速度，水平速度上限 5 m/s，反向轉向乘數 1.4；不可改變垂直速度或提供額外跳躍。
prompt.en: Use 9 m/s² horizontal air acceleration with a 5 m/s cap and a 1.4 reversal multiplier; steering must not alter vertical speed or grant extra height.
prompt.ja: 空中の左右入力に9 m/s²の加速度、水平上限5 m/s、反転倍率1.4を設定し、垂直速度やジャンプ高度は増やさないでください。

ACT-09.params: anticipation duration · key pose · attack direction · startup timing · release cue
ACT-09.impl: Insert a clear preparatory pose before the main action, oriented to reveal direction and force. Keep its visual duration aligned with the intended startup while preserving responsive timing for player-controlled actions.

prompt.zh: 為敵人向下重擊加入 180 ms 預備動作：先把武器拉高並停留 40 ms，再清楚朝目標方向釋放；攻擊判定只可在釋放後開始。
prompt.en: Give the enemy's downward heavy strike a 180 ms anticipation: raise the weapon with a 40 ms hold, then release clearly toward the target; activate the hit only after release begins.
prompt.ja: 敵の振り下ろし強攻撃に180 msの予備動作を付け、武器を持ち上げて40 ms止めてから目標方向へ振ってください。攻撃判定は振り始めた後だけ有効にしてください。

ACT-10.params: squash scale · stretch scale · apparent volume · recovery duration · collider policy
ACT-10.impl: Apply brief nonuniform visual scaling around impacts and launches, compensating other axes to preserve apparent volume. Keep gameplay collision unchanged unless the design explicitly calls for a separate rule.

prompt.zh: 着地時把角色外觀壓至高度 85%、闊度 108%，用 120 ms 回復；起跳首 80 ms 拉至高度 112%、闊度 94%，碰撞體保持不變。
prompt.en: On landing, squash the visual to 85% height and 108% width, recovering over 120 ms; for the first 80 ms of takeoff, stretch to 112% height and 94% width, without changing the collider.
prompt.ja: 着地時に見た目を高さ85%・幅108%へつぶして120 msで戻し、跳び始めの80 msは高さ112%・幅94%へ伸ばしてください。コライダーは変更しないでください。

ACT-11.params: total duration · pose timestamps · sample spacing · acceleration impression · key poses
ACT-11.impl: Choose when important poses occur, then shape the distances traveled between equal-time samples. Timing establishes rhythm, while spacing establishes the perceived speed between those poses.

prompt.zh: 製作 600 ms 抬手動作，以每 100 ms 取樣：首三段位移 2、4、8 cm，後三段 8、4、2 cm，總時長不變但呈現先加速後減速。
prompt.en: Create a 600 ms arm raise sampled every 100 ms, with successive travel distances of 2, 4, 8, 8, 4, and 2 cm, preserving duration while showing acceleration then deceleration.
prompt.ja: 600 msの腕上げを100 msごとに取り、移動距離を順に2、4、8、8、4、2 cmとして、総時間を変えずに加速から減速へ見せてください。

ACT-12.params: curve shape · ease-in ratio · ease-out ratio · tangent slope · impact exception
ACT-12.impl: Use a curve with shallow slopes near selected endpoints and a steeper middle section. Reserve abrupt slope changes for impacts or deliberately sharp actions rather than easing every movement uniformly.

prompt.zh: 把 500 ms 手部移動設為首 20% 漸入、末 30% 漸出，中段較快；碰撞一刻則在 1 個更新內急停，不套用末段緩停。
prompt.en: For a 500 ms hand motion, ease in over the first 20% and ease out over the last 30%, with a faster middle; if it impacts, stop within one update instead of applying the final ease.
prompt.ja: 500 msの手の移動を最初の20%でイーズイン、最後の30%でイーズアウトし、中間を速くしてください。衝突時は終端イーズを使わず1更新以内で止めてください。

ACT-13.params: primary stop time · trailing delay · damping · settle duration · control independence
ACT-13.impl: Let flexible parts continue after the main body reaches its stop, then damp them toward rest. Treat this residual visual motion independently from whether gameplay control has returned.

prompt.zh: 角色急停後讓披風多擺 2 次：首擺幅 18°、次擺幅 7°，在 420 ms 內穩定；玩家操控須在身體停下時立即恢復。
prompt.en: After the character stops abruptly, let the cape swing twice at 18° then 7° and settle within 420 ms; return player control as soon as the body stops.
prompt.ja: キャラクターの急停止後、マントを18°、次に7°の2回振らせ、420 ms以内に収束させてください。操作は本体が止まった時点で戻してください。

ACT-14.params: part hierarchy · start offsets · stop offsets · drag amount · overlap duration
ACT-14.impl: Offset the start and stop times of connected body regions so motion propagates through the hierarchy. Use small delays for drag during the main action, distinct from the settling motion that follows it.

prompt.zh: 180° 轉身時軀幹先動，肩延遲 35 ms、雙手延遲 65 ms、頭髮延遲 90 ms，並把各部分停止時間錯開 40 ms。
prompt.en: For a 180° turn, start the torso first, delay the shoulders by 35 ms, hands by 65 ms, and hair by 90 ms, with each region's stop offset by another 40 ms.
prompt.ja: 180°の振り向きで胴体を先に動かし、肩を35 ms、手を65 ms、髪を90 ms遅らせ、各部位の停止も40 msずつずらしてください。

ACT-15.params: arc control points · path curvature · travel duration · orientation along path · hit path separation
ACT-15.impl: Guide important limb or prop positions through a smooth curved path using a small set of control points. Evaluate gameplay hit detection separately instead of assuming the visible trail defines it.

prompt.zh: 讓劍尖在 320 ms 內沿半徑 1.1 m、約 140° 的平滑弧線揮過，移除中途折角；傷害判定另用 3 段時間窗口設定。
prompt.en: Move the sword tip through a smooth 140° arc of roughly 1.1 m radius over 320 ms, removing angular kinks; define damage detection separately in three timed segments.
prompt.ja: 剣先を320 msで半径約1.1 m・140°の滑らかな弧に沿って動かし、途中の折れをなくしてください。ダメージ判定は別途3つの時間区間で設定してください。

ACT-16.params: primary action · secondary gesture · gesture amplitude · focus hierarchy · emotional intent
ACT-16.impl: Layer a restrained expressive gesture onto the main action, ensuring its timing and silhouette support rather than obscure the primary read. Use the gesture to communicate a specific emotion or intention.

prompt.zh: 在 2.4 秒步行循環中加入 300 ms 握拳次要動作，手指收緊幅度控制在完整握拳的 70%，步伐與身體輪廓仍須保持清楚。
prompt.en: Add a 300 ms fist-clench secondary action within a 2.4 s walk cycle, reaching 70% of a full clench while keeping the gait and body silhouette clearly readable.
prompt.ja: 2.4秒の歩行ループに300 msの拳を握る副次動作を加え、握りを最大の70%に抑えつつ、歩行と全身シルエットを明瞭に保ってください。

ACT-17.params: silhouette separation · camera angle · contrast · effect density · attack direction
ACT-17.impl: Arrange pose, camera, background contrast, and effects so the important action reads as a distinct silhouette. Remove or redirect elements that obscure the weapon path or intended target.

prompt.zh: 為敵人斬擊預備姿勢保留武器與軀幹至少 12 px 輪廓間隙，背景亮度差達 25%，並在出招前 250 ms 把非必要特效減至一半。
prompt.en: Stage the enemy's slash anticipation with at least 12 px of silhouette separation between weapon and torso, 25% background luminance contrast, and half the nonessential effects during the 250 ms tell.
prompt.ja: 敵の斬撃予備姿勢で武器と胴体のシルエットを最低12 px離し、背景との輝度差を25%確保し、250 msの予告中は不要なエフェクトを半分にしてください。

ACT-18.params: startup duration · first active instant · input timestamp · telegraph pose · frame convention
ACT-18.impl: Represent startup as the interval from accepted input until attack detection first becomes active. Document whether the first active update is included in reported startup counts to avoid off-by-one ambiguity.

prompt.zh: 重攻擊輸入後設 240 ms 起手，攻擊判定只在第 241 ms 起啟用；前 160 ms 顯示抬手提示，並清楚記錄計時是否包含首個有效更新。
prompt.en: Give the heavy attack 240 ms of startup and enable attack detection from 241 ms onward; show a readable arm raise for the first 160 ms and document whether the first active update is included in timing counts.
prompt.ja: 強攻撃に240 msの発生前時間を設け、攻撃判定は241 msから有効にしてください。最初の160 msは腕を上げる予告を見せ、最初の有効更新を計数に含むか明記してください。

ACT-19.params: active intervals · hit volume · target filters · repeat-hit rule · contact state
ACT-19.impl: Enable attack detection only during explicit active intervals and test it against valid targets and protection rules. Track prior contacts when a move should hit each target only once.

prompt.zh: 劍擊在 240–330 ms 啟用攻擊判定，共 90 ms；每個目標只可命中一次，距離不足、無敵或已命中時均不可造成接觸效果。
prompt.en: Activate the sword hit volume from 240 to 330 ms for a 90 ms window; allow one hit per target and reject contacts that are out of range, invulnerable, or already recorded.
prompt.ja: 剣の攻撃判定を240～330 msの90 ms間だけ有効にし、対象ごとに1回のみ命中させ、範囲外・無敵中・命中済みの接触は無効にしてください。

ACT-20.params: recovery duration · action lockout · allowed cancels · cooldown separation · whiff modifier
ACT-20.impl: After active detection ends, keep selected actions unavailable for a defined recovery interval. Track recovery separately from visual animation tails and skill cooldowns, and expose only intentional cancel routes.

prompt.zh: 重攻擊有效期結束後加入 420 ms 收招硬直；首 300 ms 不可攻擊或閃避，末 120 ms 只可格擋，而技能冷卻另計 2.0 秒。
prompt.en: After the heavy attack's active window, add 420 ms of recovery: disallow attacks and dodges for 300 ms, allow only guard during the final 120 ms, and track a separate 2.0 s skill cooldown.
prompt.ja: 強攻撃の持続終了後に420 msの硬直を設け、最初の300 msは攻撃と回避を禁止し、最後の120 msはガードのみ許可してください。技のクールダウン2.0秒は別に管理してください。

ACT-21.params: pause duration · affected actors · timer domains · input policy · effect policy
ACT-21.impl: On a confirmed hit, pause the selected attacker and target simulation clocks for a short interval while deciding independently whether input, effects, camera, and environment continue. Resume from the held contact poses without converting the pause into hitstun.

prompt.zh: 重擊命中時讓攻擊者停 55 ms、受擊者停 75 ms；背景與輸入採樣繼續，火花照常播放，停頓結束後才開始計 260 ms 受擊硬直。
prompt.en: On a heavy hit, pause the attacker for 55 ms and the target for 75 ms while background motion, input sampling, and sparks continue; begin the 260 ms hitstun only after the pause.
prompt.ja: 強攻撃の命中時、攻撃側を55 ms、被弾側を75 ms停止し、背景・入力取得・火花は継続してください。260 msの被弾硬直は停止終了後から数えてください。

ACT-22.params: stun duration · control lockout · reaction pose · escape options · combo scaling
ACT-22.impl: Apply a timed action restriction after a valid hit while allowing explicitly listed escape or defensive actions. Keep the reaction animation and health change separate from the authoritative stun state.

prompt.zh: 普通命中施加 280 ms 受擊硬直，期間禁止移動與攻擊，但在最後 80 ms 容許一次耗資源脫離；受擊動畫不可單獨決定失控時間。
prompt.en: Apply 280 ms of hitstun on a normal hit, blocking movement and attacks but allowing one resource-cost escape during the final 80 ms; do not derive control lockout solely from the reaction animation.
prompt.ja: 通常ヒットで280 msの被弾硬直を与え、移動と攻撃を禁止しつつ、最後の80 msだけ資源を消費する脱出を1回許可してください。操作不能時間をリアクションアニメだけで決めないでください。

ACT-23.params: blockstun duration · guard pushback · chip policy · counter options · guard state
ACT-23.impl: On a successful block, apply a distinct timed restriction and any configured pushback without treating it as a guard break. Define permitted guard cancels and health effects explicitly per attack.

prompt.zh: 成功格擋輕攻擊後施加 160 ms 格擋硬直及 0.35 m 推離，不扣血；最後 40 ms 可用一次防禦取消，但不可當作破防。
prompt.en: After blocking a light attack, apply 160 ms of blockstun and 0.35 m of pushback with no health loss; permit one guard cancel during the final 40 ms without treating it as a guard break.
prompt.ja: 弱攻撃のガード成功時に160 msのガード硬直と0.35 mの押し戻しを与え、体力は減らさないでください。最後の40 msだけガードキャンセルを1回許可し、ガードブレイク扱いにはしないでください。

ACT-24.params: source state · destination action · cancel permission · transition cost · hit condition
ACT-24.impl: Define explicit transitions that may interrupt a source action before its normal completion. Validate destination, timing, hit state, and resource cost in gameplay rules rather than inferring permission from visual blending.

prompt.zh: 輕攻擊命中後可在動作完成前取消至重攻擊或閃避：重攻擊消耗 20 能量，閃避消耗 30；揮空時兩者都不可提前切換。
prompt.en: After a light attack hits, allow cancellation into heavy attack for 20 energy or dodge for 30 before the animation ends; permit neither early transition on whiff.
prompt.ja: 弱攻撃が命中した場合のみ、終了前にエネルギー20で強攻撃、30で回避へキャンセル可能にし、空振り時はどちらも早期遷移できないようにしてください。

ACT-25.params: window start · window end · destination filter · hit requirement · input buffer
