ACT-25.impl: Open and close cancel permission at explicit points in the source action, with conditions per destination and contact result. Store early input in a separate bounded buffer, then execute it only once the cancel window opens.

prompt.zh: 攻擊的閃避取消窗口設於 360–480 ms，並保存提早 90 ms 內的閃避輸入；窗口前只記錄按鍵，不可立即轉換，逾時即丟棄。
prompt.en: Set the attack's dodge-cancel window to 360–480 ms and buffer dodge inputs up to 90 ms early; before the window, remember the press without transitioning, then discard it on timeout.
prompt.ja: 攻撃の回避キャンセル受付を360～480 msに設定し、最大90 ms前の回避入力を保存してください。受付前は遷移せず記録だけ行い、時間切れなら破棄してください。

ACT-26.params: attacker unlock · defender unlock · on-hit value · on-block value · distance context
ACT-26.impl: Measure advantage as the difference between when the attacker and defender can next act after contact. Report hit and block outcomes separately, and evaluate follow-ups with startup, distance, and special defenses rather than the sign alone.

prompt.zh: 格擋後攻擊者在 420 ms 解鎖、防守者在 460 ms 解鎖，顯示為 +40 ms；另列命中時 +90 ms，並檢查 180 ms 起手的下一招是否真的夠距離接上。
prompt.en: If the attacker unlocks at 420 ms after a block and the defender at 460 ms, report +40 ms; also report +90 ms on hit and test whether a 180 ms follow-up actually reaches at the resulting distance.
prompt.ja: ガード後に攻撃側が420 ms、防御側が460 msで行動可能になる場合は+40 msと表示し、ヒット時は別に+90 msとしてください。発生180 msの次の技が実際の距離で届くかも確認してください。

ACT-27.params: invulnerable channels · start time · end time · hurtbox state · rehit protection
ACT-27.impl: During a defined action interval, reject only the configured damage or grab categories while leaving other interactions intact. Distinguish rule-based invulnerability from attacks missing because hurtboxes moved.

prompt.zh: 翻滾開始後 80–260 ms 對打擊與飛行道具無敵，但投技仍有效；保留受擊盒供除錯顯示，並由規則明確拒絕指定類型。
prompt.en: From 80 to 260 ms after a roll starts, grant invulnerability to strikes and projectiles while throws remain valid; keep hurtboxes visible in debug and reject the specified channels by rule.
prompt.ja: ローリング開始後80～260 msは打撃と飛び道具に無敵とし、投げは有効のままにしてください。デバッグでは喰らい判定を表示し、指定種別をルールで拒否してください。

ACT-28.params: armor interval · hit capacity · damage threshold · interrupt exceptions · damage policy
ACT-28.impl: While armor is active, process damage normally unless configured otherwise but suppress ordinary interruption within its capacity. Break or bypass armor on explicit hit counts, thresholds, throws, or other exception categories.

prompt.zh: 重攻擊的 180–520 ms 啟用可承受 2 次打擊的霸體：傷害照扣，第 3 擊或單次傷害超過 40 即中斷，投技直接無視霸體。
prompt.en: Give the heavy attack two-hit armor from 180 to 520 ms: damage still applies, the third hit or any single hit above 40 interrupts, and throws bypass armor.
prompt.ja: 強攻撃の180～520 msに2発分のアーマーを付け、ダメージは通常どおり受け、3発目または単発40超で中断し、投げはアーマーを無視してください。

ACT-29.params: push distance · push duration · direction · stun duration · wall response
ACT-29.impl: Compute displacement from contact direction and apply it over its own duration, separately from any action lockout. Define wall and corner behavior so spacing changes remain predictable.

prompt.zh: 普通命中把目標沿接觸反方向推 1.2 m、歷時 180 ms，同時施加獨立的 300 ms 受擊硬直；遇牆時停止位移但硬直照常計。
prompt.en: On a normal hit, push the target 1.2 m away from contact over 180 ms while applying a separate 300 ms hitstun; stop displacement at walls without shortening the stun.
prompt.ja: 通常ヒット時、接触の反対方向へ1.2 mを180 msかけて押し、別に300 msの被弾硬直を与えてください。壁では移動だけ止め、硬直時間は短縮しないでください。

ACT-30.params: root translation · root rotation · extraction scale · collision sweep · control blend
ACT-30.impl: Extract authored root translation and rotation each update and apply them to world movement through normal collision checks. Blend or constrain player steering explicitly rather than assuming root-driven actions forbid correction.

prompt.zh: 突刺動畫的根節點在 700 ms 內前進 2.4 m 並轉向 15°；把位移套用至角色碰撞體並逐段掃描碰撞，同時容許玩家修正最多 ±8°。
prompt.en: For a thrust animation whose root travels 2.4 m and rotates 15° over 700 ms, apply that motion to the character collider with swept collision and allow up to ±8° of player steering.
prompt.ja: 700 msでルートが2.4 m前進し15°回転する突きアニメについて、その移動をスイープ衝突付きでキャラクターへ適用し、プレイヤーの方向補正を±8°まで許可してください。

ACT-31.params: controller speed · animation rate · stride length · turn rate · foot phase
ACT-31.impl: Drive world-space translation and rotation from movement rules while the locomotion clip has no net root travel. Match playback rate and gait selection to controller speed to limit visible foot sliding.

prompt.zh: 用程式以 4.5 m/s 推動角色，播放沒有根節點淨前移的跑步循環；按 3.6 m 步幅調整播放率，並把轉向上限設為每秒 540°。
prompt.en: Move the character by code at 4.5 m/s while playing a run cycle with no net root travel; scale playback for a 3.6 m stride and cap turning at 540° per second.
prompt.ja: ルートの正味移動がない走行ループを再生しつつ、コードで4.5 m/s移動させ、歩幅3.6 mに合わせて再生速度を調整し、旋回を毎秒540°までにしてください。

ACT-32.params: source weight · target weight · blend duration · curve · interruption policy
ACT-32.impl: Interpolate pose weights from the source animation to the target over a bounded transition using an appropriate curve. Keep transition smoothness separate from gameplay permission to interrupt an action.

prompt.zh: 站立轉步行使用 180 ms 交叉淡化，來源權重由 1 降至 0、目標由 0 升至 1，採平滑曲線；攻擊轉閃避仍須另過取消規則。
prompt.en: Crossfade idle to walk over 180 ms, lowering source weight from 1 to 0 and raising target weight from 0 to 1 on a smooth curve; attack-to-dodge transitions must still pass separate cancel rules.
prompt.ja: 待機から歩行へ180 msでクロスフェードし、元の重みを1から0、遷移先を0から1へ滑らかに変えてください。攻撃から回避への遷移は別のキャンセル規則で判定してください。

ACT-33.params: speed parameter · direction parameter · sample positions · weight normalization · playback scaling
ACT-33.impl: Map movement parameters into a sample space or tree and blend nearby locomotion poses with normalized weights. Treat the chosen organization explicitly; it need not be a motion-matching system.

prompt.zh: 建立 0–6 m/s 一維移動混合：0 用站立、1.8 用步行、4.0 用慢跑、6.0 用跑步；在樣本間線性混合並把權重總和維持為 1。
prompt.en: Create a one-dimensional 0–6 m/s locomotion blend with idle at 0, walk at 1.8, jog at 4.0, and run at 6.0; blend linearly between neighboring samples with weights summing to 1.
prompt.ja: 0～6 m/sの1次元移動ブレンドを作り、0に待機、1.8に歩行、4.0にジョグ、6.0に走行を配置し、隣接サンプルを重み合計1で線形補間してください。

ACT-34.params: base layer · upper-body mask · layer weight · override mode · blend boundary
ACT-34.impl: Evaluate a base full-body pose, then apply another animation only to bones selected by a mask. Specify whether the layer overrides or adds offsets and soften weights near the mask boundary when needed.

prompt.zh: 跑步作基礎全身層，上半身裝填以脊椎第 2 節至雙手的骨骼遮罩覆蓋，權重 0.85；骨盆與雙腳維持跑步，肩部邊界用 100 ms 淡入。
prompt.en: Use running as the full-body base and override from spine bone 2 through both hands with a reload layer at 0.85 weight; keep pelvis and legs running and fade the shoulder boundary in over 100 ms.
prompt.ja: 走行を全身ベースにし、背骨の第2ボーンから両手までをリロード層で重み0.85の上書きにしてください。骨盤と脚は走行を維持し、肩の境界を100 msでフェードインしてください。

ACT-35.params: reference pose · additive delta · layer weight · pose space · affected bones
ACT-35.impl: Compute the animation's change relative to a declared reference pose in a consistent pose space, then compose that delta over the base action. Limit bones and weight so the overlay does not replace the underlying gait.

prompt.zh: 以武器待機姿勢作參考，把 6° 後座旋轉及 3 cm 肩膀後移作加法偏移疊到跑步，權重 0.7，120 ms 內回零，雙腳不受影響。
prompt.en: Relative to the weapon-idle reference pose, add 6° of recoil rotation and 3 cm of shoulder travel over the run at 0.7 weight, returning to zero within 120 ms without affecting the legs.
prompt.ja: 武器待機ポーズを基準に、6°の反動回転と肩の3 cm後退を重み0.7で走行へ加算し、120 ms以内にゼロへ戻してください。脚には適用しないでください。

ACT-36.params: end-effector target · chain length · joint limits · solver weight · FK base pose
ACT-36.impl: Author the main motion with direct joint rotations, then solve selected bone chains toward hand or foot targets. Clamp unreachable targets and joint limits, and blend solver weight to avoid snapping.

prompt.zh: 保留 FK 步行姿勢，再用兩節腿 IK 把腳掌貼合 ±25° 斜坡；每隻腳的解算權重在 120 ms 內由 0 升至 1，超出腿長 95% 的目標要夾限。
prompt.en: Keep the FK walk pose, then use two-bone leg IK to align feet to slopes up to ±25°; blend each solver from 0 to 1 over 120 ms and clamp targets beyond 95% of leg reach.
prompt.ja: FKの歩行ポーズを保ち、2ボーン脚IKで足裏を±25°までの斜面へ合わせてください。各ソルバーを120 msで0から1へブレンドし、脚の到達距離95%を超える目標は制限してください。

ACT-37.params: warp window · target transform · translation scale · rotation scale · collision validation
ACT-37.impl: During a marked interval, redistribute authored root translation and rotation so the action reaches a nearby target transform. Limit correction magnitude and validate the adjusted path against collision; warping should not guarantee a hit.

prompt.zh: 翻越動作在 220–680 ms 扭配根運動以對準障礙頂點，最多修正前後 0.6 m、左右 0.25 m 及朝向 20°；路徑碰撞失敗時取消動作。
prompt.en: Warp root motion from 220 to 680 ms to align a vault with the obstacle top, limiting correction to 0.6 m forward/back, 0.25 m sideways, and 20° facing; abort if the adjusted path fails collision validation.
prompt.ja: 乗り越え動作の220～680 msでルートモーションを障害物上端へ合わせ、前後0.6 m、左右0.25 m、向き20°までに補正を制限し、経路の衝突検証に失敗したら中止してください。

ACT-38.params: event timestamp · state interval · payload · duplicate guard · authority boundary
ACT-38.impl: Associate one-shot callbacks and bounded state intervals with animation timeline positions, then dispatch them reliably when those positions are crossed. Keep cosmetic synchronization separate from authoritative hit or network decisions where required.

prompt.zh: 在步行循環 18% 與 68% 位置各觸發一次腳步聲；劍擊 240–360 ms 開啟拖尾通知區段並在結束關閉，但傷害仍由獨立戰鬥規則判定。
prompt.en: Trigger one footstep at 18% and another at 68% of the walk cycle; enable a sword-trail state from 240 to 360 ms and disable it on exit, while damage remains authoritative in separate combat rules.
prompt.ja: 歩行ループの18%と68%で足音を1回ずつ発火し、剣の軌跡通知区間を240～360 msだけ有効にして終了時に切ってください。ダメージ判定は別の戦闘規則で管理してください。

FX-01.params: spawn rate · sprite size · facing mode · velocity alignment · lifetime · opacity curve
FX-01.impl: Emit textured planes and choose camera-facing, axis-locked, or velocity-aligned orientation per effect. Vary size, rotation, and opacity over lifetime so the group creates volume without implying physical geometry.

prompt.zh: 製作一團持續 2.5 秒的魔法煙霧：每秒生成 40 張半透明貼片，七成面向鏡頭、三成沿速度方向對齊，尺寸由 0.15 米放大至 0.6 米並逐步淡出。
prompt.en: Create a 2.5-second magical smoke puff that emits 40 translucent planes per second; face 70% toward the camera, align 30% to velocity, and grow each from 0.15 m to 0.6 m while fading out.
prompt.ja: 2.5秒続く魔法の煙を作成し、半透明の平面を毎秒40枚放出してください。70%はカメラ向き、30%は速度方向に合わせ、各要素を0.15 mから0.6 mへ拡大しながらフェードアウトさせてください。

FX-02.params: sample interval · ribbon width · history length · UV tiling · taper · fade time
FX-02.impl: Sample a moving attachment point and connect recent positions into a continuous strip. Taper and fade older samples while keeping the rendered path distinct from separately emitted smoke particles.

prompt.zh: 為刀尖製作 0.35 秒長的揮砍拖尾，每 8 毫秒記錄一次位置，帶寬由 12 厘米收窄至 0，尾端在 0.18 秒內淡走，清楚顯示完整揮砍弧線。
prompt.en: Build a 0.35-second sword-tip trail sampled every 8 ms, taper its width from 12 cm to zero, and fade the tail over 0.18 seconds so the full swing arc remains readable.
prompt.ja: 剣先に0.35秒分のトレイルを作り、8ミリ秒ごとに位置を記録してください。幅を12 cmから0まで細くし、末端を0.18秒で消して、斬撃の弧全体を読み取れるようにしてください。

FX-03.params: snapshot interval · ghost count · pose retention · tint · opacity decay · silhouette offset
FX-03.impl: Capture discrete character silhouettes or simplified pose proxies at timed positions, then fade each independently. Preserve visible gaps between ghosts so the result reads as repeated poses rather than continuous motion blur.

prompt.zh: 為 6 米衝刺加入 5 個殘影，每隔 70 毫秒保留一次姿勢；首個殘影透明度設為 55%，各自在 0.4 秒內淡出，輪廓之間要有明顯空隙。
prompt.en: Add five afterimages to a 6 m dash, retaining one pose every 70 ms; start the first ghost at 55% opacity and fade each over 0.4 seconds, with clear gaps between silhouettes.
prompt.ja: 6 mのダッシュに残像を5体追加し、70ミリ秒ごとにポーズを1つ残してください。最初の残像は不透明度55%から始め、各残像を0.4秒で消し、輪郭同士の間隔を明確にしてください。

FX-04.params: frame count · playback rate · atlas layout · frame blending · lifetime · random start
FX-04.impl: Store the evolving shape as ordered frames in a texture atlas and advance the frame index over particle lifetime. Keep frame playback independent from scale and opacity curves so the interior visibly changes instead of merely enlarging.

prompt.zh: 用 8×8 圖集製作 64 格爆炸動畫，以每秒 32 格播放 2 秒；同時只把整體尺寸由 0.4 米放大至 2.2 米，確保內部火焰輪廓每格都有變化。
prompt.en: Create a 64-frame explosion from an 8×8 atlas, play it at 32 fps for 2 seconds, and scale the carrier only from 0.4 m to 2.2 m while ensuring the internal flame silhouette changes every frame.
prompt.ja: 8×8のアトラスから64フレームの爆発を作り、32 fpsで2秒間再生してください。表示面は0.4 mから2.2 mまで拡大しつつ、炎の内部形状が毎フレーム変化するようにしてください。

FX-05.params: mesh set · spawn count · angular velocity · scale range · ballistic arc · lifetime · collision mode
FX-05.impl: Spawn lightweight mesh instances with independent translation, rotation, and scale curves. Use preset ballistic motion unless actual collision response is required; visible thickness alone should not imply rigid-body simulation.

prompt.zh: 命中石牆時生成 18 塊立體碎石，從 4 款網格中抽選，初速設為每秒 3–7 米、旋轉速度每秒 180–540 度，於 1.4 秒內落下並淡出，不啟用剛體碰撞。
prompt.en: On a stone-wall hit, spawn 18 three-dimensional fragments selected from four meshes, launch them at 3–7 m/s with 180–540°/s rotation, and let them fall and fade within 1.4 seconds without rigid-body collision.
prompt.ja: 石壁への命中時に4種類のメッシュから18個の立体破片を生成し、初速3～7 m/s、回転速度180～540°/sで飛ばしてください。剛体衝突は使わず、1.4秒以内に落下して消えるようにしてください。

FX-06.params: projection size · surface offset · normal alignment · lifetime · opacity · receiver mask · edge feather
FX-06.impl: Project or place a surface-aligned mark only on eligible receivers, with a small depth offset to avoid flicker. Fade or remove it according to gameplay state without assuming that every surface mark requires a dedicated decal renderer.

prompt.zh: 每次火球命中後留下直徑 0.9 米的焦痕，貼合牆面或地面法線，離表面偏移 2 毫米，邊緣羽化 8 厘米，維持 6 秒後用 1 秒淡出。
prompt.en: After each fireball hit, leave a 0.9 m scorch mark aligned to the wall or floor normal, offset it 2 mm from the surface, feather the edge by 8 cm, hold it for 6 seconds, then fade it over 1 second.
prompt.ja: 火球が命中するたびに直径0.9 mの焦げ跡を残し、壁または床の法線に合わせて表面から2 mm離してください。縁を8 cmぼかし、6秒維持した後に1秒で消してください。

FX-07.params: distortion strength · screen radius · normal map speed · falloff · duration · chromatic offset
FX-07.impl: Render a localized displacement field that samples and offsets the already rendered background. Limit the effect spatially and temporally so it reads as local heat or refraction rather than whole-camera movement.

prompt.zh: 製作一個由半徑 0.2 米擴至 2.5 米的衝擊扭曲圈，歷時 0.45 秒；中心位移上限為畫面寬度 1.5%，外緣在最後 0.12 秒歸零，不要移動整個鏡頭。
prompt.en: Create a shock-distortion ring that expands from a 0.2 m to 2.5 m radius over 0.45 seconds; cap displacement at 1.5% of screen width and reduce it to zero at the rim during the final 0.12 seconds without moving the camera.
prompt.ja: 半径0.2 mから2.5 mへ0.45秒で広がる衝撃の歪みリングを作成してください。変位は画面幅の1.5%以下にし、最後の0.12秒で外縁をゼロまで弱め、カメラ自体は動かさないでください。

FX-08.params: warning duration · area shape · radius · active duration · boundary width · timing cue · team state
FX-08.impl: Drive the warning cue and the affected-area display from the same gameplay geometry and timing data. Distinguish the pre-action telegraph from any area that remains active after impact through animation, labeling, or state change.

prompt.zh: 為半徑 4 米的地面重擊加入 1.2 秒預警：首 0.9 秒顯示穩定圓形邊界，最後 0.3 秒加快脈衝至每秒 4 次；命中後把區域改為 2 秒持續傷害狀態。
prompt.en: Add a 1.2-second telegraph for a 4 m radius ground slam: show a stable circular boundary for 0.9 seconds, pulse it four times per second during the final 0.3 seconds, then change it to a distinct 2-second active-damage state after impact.
prompt.ja: 半径4 mの地面叩きつけに1.2秒の予告を追加してください。最初の0.9秒は安定した円形境界を表示し、最後の0.3秒は毎秒4回点滅させ、命中後は見た目を変えて2秒間の持続ダメージ範囲にしてください。

FX-09.params: contact position · burst duration · spike count · debris count · peak brightness · scale curve · material response
FX-09.impl: Spawn a short, localized burst at the confirmed contact point, with its main shape peaking immediately and resolving quickly. Keep attack-swing decoration separate so the burst functions as unambiguous hit confirmation.

prompt.zh: 近戰確認命中時，在接觸點生成 10 條放射尖光和 6 粒碎屑；主爆點於 30 毫秒達到最大 0.7 米，總長 0.16 秒，未命中時完全不要播放。
prompt.en: On a confirmed melee hit, spawn 10 radial spikes and six debris pieces at the contact point; make the main burst reach a 0.7 m maximum in 30 ms and end within 0.16 seconds, with no burst on a miss.
prompt.ja: 近接攻撃の命中が確定したときだけ、接触点に放射状の光10本と破片6個を生成してください。主バーストは30ミリ秒で最大0.7 mに達し、全体を0.16秒以内に終了させ、空振り時は再生しないでください。

FX-10.params: silhouette family · directionality · curvature · aspect ratio · enclosure · repetition · grayscale readability
FX-10.impl: Define a small, consistent silhouette vocabulary for direction, spread, enclosure, and state. Validate each family without color and teach its meaning through repeated use within the same product rather than relying on universal symbolism.

prompt.zh: 建立 3 組招式形狀：直線攻擊用長寬比 5:1 的前指尖形、範圍爆發用完整圓環、防護用包住角色的閉合罩；每組製作 4 個變體，轉成灰階後仍要一眼分辨。
prompt.en: Define three ability-shape families: a forward-pointing 5:1 form for linear attacks, a complete ring for radial bursts, and a closed shell around the character for protection; create four variants of each that remain distinguishable in grayscale.
prompt.ja: アビリティの形状を3系統定義してください。直線攻撃は前方を指す比率5:1の形、範囲爆発は完全な円環、防御はキャラクターを包む閉じた殻とし、各4種類を作ってグレースケールでも即座に区別できるようにしてください。

FX-11.params: primary silhouette · secondary count · size ratio · luminance ratio · onset order · detail density · thumbnail scale
FX-11.impl: Build the effect around one dominant form that communicates direction or coverage, then add lower-contrast supporting details. Check the result at reduced size and remove details that compete with the primary message.

prompt.zh: 為重擊先做一個佔畫面效果面積約 70% 的主弧形，再加入最多 12 粒火星和 2 層薄煙；輔助元素峰值亮度不得超過主形的 60%，縮至 25% 尺寸仍要看清攻擊方向。
prompt.en: Build a heavy strike around one primary arc occupying about 70% of the effect area, then add at most 12 sparks and two thin smoke layers; keep supporting peak luminance below 60% of the main form and preserve attack direction at 25% display size.
prompt.ja: 重攻撃はエフェクト面積の約70%を占める主弧を先に作り、火花は最大12個、薄い煙は2層まで追加してください。補助要素の最大輝度を主形状の60%未満に抑え、表示を25%に縮小しても攻撃方向を読めるようにしてください。

FX-12.params: focal value · support value · saturation range · background contrast · grayscale groups · peak area
FX-12.impl: Assign distinct value and saturation bands to the focal event, supporting forms, and background. Review in grayscale and against representative scenes because saturation alone cannot guarantee separation.

prompt.zh: 把技能核心限制在最亮的首 10% 面積，主形與背景維持至少 30% 明度差，陪襯飽和度降至核心的約一半；在 3 款場景截圖上做灰階檢查，焦點仍須清楚。
prompt.en: Reserve the brightest values for the central 10% of the ability, maintain at least a 30% value difference between the main form and background, and reduce supporting saturation to roughly half the core; verify the focal point in grayscale over three representative scenes.
prompt.ja: アビリティ中央の10%だけに最も明るい値を割り当て、主形状と背景の明度差を30%以上に保ち、補助要素の彩度を中心の約半分にしてください。代表的な3つの場面でグレースケール確認を行い、焦点が明確か検証してください。

FX-13.params: anticipation duration · contraction amount · light buildup · directional cue · preparatory sound · release frame
FX-13.impl: Stage a visible and audible preparation before release, such as contraction, gathering light, or direction establishment. Align its release with gameplay timing while allowing the presentation interval to differ from the complete startup interval.

prompt.zh: 為直線能量炮製作 0.8 秒預備段：首 0.5 秒把光點由 1.2 米收縮至 0.25 米，最後 0.3 秒亮度升至 180%，並在發射前 100 毫秒加入短促提示音。
prompt.en: Create a 0.8-second anticipation for a linear energy blast: contract light from 1.2 m to 0.25 m during the first 0.5 seconds, raise brightness to 180% over the final 0.3 seconds, and add a short cue 100 ms before release.
prompt.ja: 直線エネルギー砲に0.8秒の予備演出を作ってください。最初の0.5秒で光を1.2 mから0.25 mへ収縮させ、最後の0.3秒で明るさを180%まで上げ、発射100ミリ秒前に短い予告音を入れてください。

FX-14.params: build duration · burst duration · hold interval · decay duration · hit spacing · speed curve · silence gap
FX-14.impl: Divide the effect into preparation, peak, and resolution phases with deliberately contrasting rates. Use gaps and hit spacing to separate beats instead of increasing density uniformly.

prompt.zh: 設計 3 擊連招節奏：每擊相隔 0.28 秒，前兩擊各用 0.08 秒爆發和 0.16 秒收尾；第三擊先停 0.18 秒，再用 0.04 秒達峰值，並以 0.6 秒慢慢消散。
prompt.en: Design a three-hit combo with 0.28 seconds between hits: give the first two hits a 0.08-second burst and 0.16-second decay, then hold for 0.18 seconds before the third hit peaks in 0.04 seconds and resolves over 0.6 seconds.
prompt.ja: 3段コンボを0.28秒間隔で設計してください。最初の2段は0.08秒で爆発し0.16秒で収束させ、3段目の前に0.18秒止めてから0.04秒でピークに達し、0.6秒かけて消散させてください。

FX-15.params: fade duration · erosion threshold · edge noise · breakup scale · residual lifetime · damage cutoff
FX-15.impl: Animate opacity for broad fading and a spatial mask for local erosion, combining them when useful. End gameplay activity independently and make the remaining decorative tail visibly non-damaging.

prompt.zh: 能量柱在傷害結束後保留 0.7 秒退場：首 0.2 秒把整體透明度降至 65%，其後 0.5 秒以噪聲遮罩由邊緣侵蝕至 100%；傷害判定必須在退場開始一刻關閉。
prompt.en: After an energy column stops dealing damage, keep a 0.7-second exit: reduce overall opacity to 65% during the first 0.2 seconds, then erode from the edges to 100% with a noise mask over 0.5 seconds; disable damage at the start of the exit.
prompt.ja: エネルギー柱のダメージ終了後に0.7秒の消散を残してください。最初の0.2秒で全体の不透明度を65%まで下げ、その後0.5秒でノイズマスクにより縁から100%侵食し、消散開始時点でダメージ判定を無効にしてください。

FX-16.params: priority tier · particle budget · screen coverage · danger boundary · character visibility · low-effects floor · crowd test
FX-16.impl: Assign effects to priority tiers and cap decorative density or coverage before reducing decision-critical cues. Test representative crowded scenes, ensuring low-effects modes preserve characters, targeting information, and hazard boundaries.

prompt.zh: 在 8 名角色同場、同時播放 12 個技能的壓力場景測試清晰度：裝飾粒子總數限制為 1,200，單個次要效果覆蓋畫面不多於 8%，低特效模式仍要保留所有危險邊界。
prompt.en: Test clarity in a stress scene with eight characters and 12 simultaneous abilities: cap decorative particles at 1,200, limit each secondary effect to no more than 8% screen coverage, and preserve every hazard boundary in low-effects mode.
prompt.ja: 8人のキャラクターと12個のアビリティが同時に存在する負荷場面で明瞭性を確認してください。装飾パーティクルを合計1,200個に制限し、各補助エフェクトの画面占有率を8%以下にして、低エフェクト設定でも危険境界をすべて残してください。

FX-17.params: onset layer · body layer · tail layer · sync offset · gain balance · frequency role · variation set
FX-17.impl: Build one event from simultaneous components with distinct roles, such as transient contact, low-frequency weight, and material tail. Balance timing and spectrum so the layers fuse without masking one another.

prompt.zh: 為重錘命中疊加 3 層聲音：20–40 毫秒的尖銳起音、約 180 毫秒的低頻主體，以及 0.8 秒碎石尾音；三層起點誤差控制在 10 毫秒內，並避免 150–300 Hz 互相遮蔽。
prompt.en: Layer a hammer impact from three simultaneous parts: a 20–40 ms sharp onset, a roughly 180 ms low-frequency body, and a 0.8-second stone-fragment tail; keep start offsets within 10 ms and prevent masking in the 150–300 Hz range.
prompt.ja: 大槌の命中音を3層で構成してください。20～40ミリ秒の鋭い立ち上がり、約180ミリ秒の低域主体、0.8秒の石片テールを重ね、開始ずれを10ミリ秒以内にし、150～300 Hzでのマスキングを避けてください。

FX-18.params: trigger event · retrigger rule · attack time · tail duration · concurrency limit · cooldown · stop behavior
FX-18.impl: Trigger the sound once per discrete event and allow it to complete without a held input. Define retrigger and concurrency behavior so rapid events remain intelligible even when one-shots overlap.

prompt.zh: 每次角色落地只觸發 1 次單次音效，起音在接觸後 20 毫秒內播放，主體約 0.25 秒、混響尾最長 1.2 秒；同一角色最多同時保留 2 個落地聲。
prompt.en: Trigger one one-shot per landing, start it within 20 ms of contact, use a roughly 0.25-second body with up to a 1.2-second reverb tail, and allow no more than two overlapping landing sounds per character.
prompt.ja: 着地1回につきワンショットを1回だけ発音し、接地から20ミリ秒以内に開始してください。本体は約0.25秒、リバーブテールは最大1.2秒とし、同一キャラクターの着地音は同時に2つまでにしてください。

FX-19.params: start segment · loop region · crossfade length · sustain gain · stop segment · release time · seam check
FX-19.impl: Separate an ongoing sound into start, seamless sustain, and stop segments controlled by the activity state. Crossfade loop boundaries and route stop requests into a deliberate release rather than cutting the waveform abruptly.

prompt.zh: 把火焰噴射器拆成 0.35 秒起動、1.6 秒無縫循環和 0.5 秒停止段；循環接點交叉淡化 40 毫秒，放開按鍵後在 60 毫秒內轉入停止段，不可出現爆音。
prompt.en: Split a flamethrower into a 0.35-second start, a seamless 1.6-second sustain loop, and a 0.5-second stop; crossfade the loop seam over 40 ms and enter the stop segment within 60 ms of release without clicks.
prompt.ja: 火炎放射器の音を0.35秒の開始、1.6秒のシームレスな持続ループ、0.5秒の停止に分けてください。ループ境界を40ミリ秒でクロスフェードし、入力解除から60ミリ秒以内に停止部分へ移行してクリック音を防いでください。

FX-20.params: sample pool · no-repeat window · pitch range · gain range · selection weight · cooldown · identity anchor
FX-20.impl: Select from a curated sample pool and vary pitch or gain within restrained ranges. Track recent choices when consecutive repetition is undesirable, while retaining common spectral features that identify the event.

prompt.zh: 為石地腳步準備 8 個樣本，採用最近 3 個不重複的抽選規則；每次音高在 ±3% 內、音量在 ±1.5 dB 內變化，連續 20 步測試時仍要保持同一材質身份。
prompt.en: Prepare eight stone-footstep samples, exclude the three most recent choices from selection, vary pitch within ±3% and gain within ±1.5 dB, and verify over 20 consecutive steps that the material identity remains consistent.
prompt.ja: 石床の足音を8サンプル用意し、直近3つを選択対象から外してください。ピッチは±3%、音量は±1.5 dBの範囲で変化させ、20歩連続でも同じ材質として聞こえることを確認してください。

FX-21.params: input parameter · normalization range · layer crossfade · pitch curve · smoothing time · update rate · fallback state
FX-21.impl: Map a normalized gameplay value to continuous gain, filter, or pitch curves and smooth incoming changes. Crossfade multiple recordings where one source cannot cover the full range naturally.

prompt.zh: 把車速 0–180 km/h 映射到 3 層引擎錄音：0–60、40–120、100–180 km/h 區間交叉淡化，參數每秒更新 30 次並以 120 毫秒平滑，避免轉速硬切。
prompt.en: Map vehicle speed from 0–180 km/h across three engine recordings covering 0–60, 40–120, and 100–180 km/h; update the parameter 30 times per second and smooth it over 120 ms to avoid abrupt RPM changes.
prompt.ja: 車速0～180 km/hを、0～60、40～120、100～180 km/hを担当する3層のエンジン録音へ割り当ててクロスフェードしてください。パラメーターを毎秒30回更新し、120ミリ秒で平滑化して回転数の急変を防いでください。

FX-22.params: azimuth · elevation · spatial blend · listener orientation · HRTF mode · pan law · localization test
FX-22.impl: Transform each source into listener-relative direction and render it with an appropriate panning or binaural method. Treat localization separately from distance attenuation and test front, rear, and elevation cues on supported outputs.

prompt.zh: 把警報聲放在聽者右後方 135°、高 2 米的位置；玩家旋轉 360° 時聲像要連續移動，以 8 個方位和 3 個高度做耳機測試，音量保持固定以獨立檢查定位。
prompt.en: Place an alarm 135° behind and to the listener’s right at a height of 2 m; as the player turns 360°, move the image continuously and test eight azimuths at three elevations on headphones while holding level constant to isolate localization.
prompt.ja: 警報音をリスナーの右後方135°、高さ2 mに配置してください。プレイヤーが360°回転すると音像が連続して移動するようにし、音量を一定に保ったまま8方位×3高度をヘッドホンで確認してください。

FX-23.params: minimum distance · maximum distance · rolloff curve · near-field plateau · floor gain · source priority
FX-23.impl: Evaluate source-listener distance against a designed attenuation curve with an optional near-field plateau and distant floor. Tune the curve for gameplay reach rather than assuming physically exact falloff.

prompt.zh: 為發電機設定距離衰減：0–3 米維持 0 dB，3–20 米平滑降至 -18 dB，20–35 米再降至 -36 dB，35 米外靜音；用 1 米間距走測，避免音量突然跳變。
prompt.en: Set generator attenuation to hold 0 dB from 0–3 m, fall smoothly to −18 dB by 20 m, reach −36 dB at 35 m, and mute beyond that; walk-test at 1 m intervals to catch abrupt level changes.
prompt.ja: 発電機の距離減衰を、0～3 mは0 dB、20 mで−18 dB、35 mで−36 dBまで滑らかに下げ、35 mより遠くでは無音に設定してください。1 m間隔で歩行確認し、音量の急変がないようにしてください。

FX-24.params: emission cone · rear attenuation · source length · attenuation volume · orientation · edge blend · listener distance
FX-24.impl: Model emission direction or spatial extent independently from output panning. Blend smoothly across cone or volume boundaries and use elongated or box regions only when they match the source’s functional shape.

prompt.zh: 為擴音器設定 60° 內錐和 120° 外錐：正面維持 0 dB，側面降至 -9 dB，背面降至 -18 dB，跨越錐邊界時用 15° 範圍平滑過渡，並固定測試距離為 5 米。
prompt.en: Give a loudspeaker a 60° inner cone and 120° outer cone: hold 0 dB in front, reduce the side to −9 dB and the rear to −18 dB, smooth transitions over 15° at cone boundaries, and test at a fixed 5 m distance.
prompt.ja: スピーカーに内側60°、外側120°の指向性コーンを設定してください。正面は0 dB、側面は−9 dB、背面は−18 dBとし、境界の15°で滑らかに補間して、距離5 m固定で確認してください。

FX-25.params: distance range · low-pass cutoff · high-shelf gain · filter slope · smoothing time · dry level · obstacle override
FX-25.impl: Map distance to gradual high-frequency reduction in addition to level attenuation. Smooth filter changes and keep distance-driven filtering distinguishable from obstacle-driven occlusion in the control logic.

prompt.zh: 為遠距槍聲加入空氣吸收：10 米內低通截止維持 18 kHz，於 10–80 米逐步降至 4.5 kHz，斜率 12 dB/oct，參數以 200 毫秒平滑；不要在穿牆時重用同一距離參數。
prompt.en: Add air absorption to distant gunfire: keep the low-pass cutoff at 18 kHz within 10 m, reduce it gradually to 4.5 kHz from 10–80 m with a 12 dB/oct slope, and smooth changes over 200 ms; do not reuse the distance parameter for wall occlusion.
prompt.ja: 遠距離の銃声に空気吸収を加え、10 m以内はローパスのカットオフを18 kHzに保ち、10～80 mで4.5 kHzまで徐々に下げてください。傾きは12 dB/oct、変化は200ミリ秒で平滑化し、壁の遮蔽には同じ距離パラメーターを使わないでください。

FX-26.params: visibility probes · direct gain · low-pass cutoff · indirect send · attack time · release time · obstacle class
FX-26.impl: Estimate blockage between source and listener with one or more visibility probes, then drive direct level, filtering, and indirect routing as separate controls. Smooth transitions and avoid presenting a simple probe as complete acoustic propagation.

prompt.zh: 每 100 毫秒以 3 條探測線檢查聲源至聽者的遮擋比例；全遮擋時直達聲降 12 dB、低通降至 1.8 kHz，進入效果用 150 毫秒、恢復用 350 毫秒，間接聲比例另行控制。
prompt.en: Check blockage between source and listener with three probes every 100 ms; at full blockage, reduce direct sound by 12 dB and low-pass it to 1.8 kHz, applying over 150 ms and recovering over 350 ms while controlling indirect sound separately.
prompt.ja: 音源とリスナーの遮蔽率を100ミリ秒ごとに3本のプローブで確認してください。完全遮蔽時は直接音を12 dB下げ、ローパスを1.8 kHzにし、適用150ミリ秒、復帰350ミリ秒で補間し、間接音は別に制御してください。

FX-27.params: dry level · wet level · decay time · pre-delay · room profile · distance send · transition time
FX-27.impl: Send sources to a room-appropriate reverberant path while preserving a controllable dry signal. Blend room changes and dry–wet ratios smoothly, and keep dense reverberation distinct from discrete delay repeats.

prompt.zh: 為石室拍手設定 25 毫秒 pre-delay 和 1.8 秒混響尾；距離 2 米時乾濕比為 80:20，距離 15 米時改為 45:55，跨房間時用 0.6 秒交叉淡化。
prompt.en: For a clap in a stone chamber, use 25 ms pre-delay and a 1.8-second reverb tail; set the dry–wet balance to 80:20 at 2 m and 45:55 at 15 m, with a 0.6-second crossfade between rooms.
prompt.ja: 石造りの部屋の拍手に25ミリ秒のプリディレイと1.8秒のリバーブテールを設定してください。距離2 mではドライ対ウェットを80:20、15 mでは45:55とし、部屋の切り替えは0.6秒でクロスフェードしてください。

FX-28.params: bus priority · dialogue headroom · frequency slot · duck amount · attack time · release time · user sliders
FX-28.impl: Organize voice, warnings, effects, ambience, and music into controllable groups with explicit priorities and headroom. Create separation through arrangement, spectrum, and level before applying selective ducking where needed.

prompt.zh: 建立音樂、語音、效果 3 個獨立音量組；重要警告出現時，音樂在 80 毫秒內降低 4 dB、於 500 毫秒恢復，並確保對白峰值保留 6 dB headroom，在 5 組混戰錄音中都可辨認。
prompt.en: Create separate music, voice, and effects controls; when a critical warning plays, lower music by 4 dB within 80 ms and recover over 500 ms, preserve 6 dB of dialogue peak headroom, and verify intelligibility in five combat captures.
prompt.ja: 音楽・音声・効果音の3つを独立して調整できるようにしてください。重要警告時は音楽を80ミリ秒で4 dB下げ、500ミリ秒で戻し、台詞のピークに6 dBのヘッドルームを確保して、5種類の戦闘録音で聞き取れるか確認してください。

FX-29.params: synchronized stems · intensity value · layer thresholds · crossfade bars · phase lock · gain matrix · exit hysteresis
FX-29.impl: Keep musical stems synchronized to a shared timeline and vary their gains or participation according to state. Quantize or smooth changes so layers enter musically without replacing the current passage.

prompt.zh: 把 120 BPM 配樂拆成鼓、低音、和聲、旋律 4 條同步音軌；威脅值超過 40% 加入低音，超過 70% 再加入鼓，每次變化跨 2 小節淡入，跌回門檻以下 10% 才退出。
prompt.en: Split a 120 BPM score into four synchronized stems—drums, bass, harmony, and melody; add bass above 40% threat and drums above 70%, crossfade each change over two bars, and remove a layer only after threat falls 10% below its threshold.
prompt.ja: 120 BPMの楽曲をドラム、ベース、ハーモニー、メロディーの同期した4ステムに分けてください。脅威度40%超でベース、70%超でドラムを加え、各変化を2小節でクロスフェードし、閾値より10%下がった時だけレイヤーを外してください。

FX-30.params: segment graph · transition marker · bar length · minimum stay · state condition · bridge segment · fallback path
FX-30.impl: Represent music as segments connected by musically valid transition points and select the next segment from gameplay state. Respect bar or phrase boundaries and provide bridge and fallback routes for state changes.

prompt.zh: 為 100 BPM 音樂建立探索、戰鬥、勝利 3 個段落；狀態改變後最遲在下一個 4 小節邊界轉接，探索至戰鬥先播 1 小節過橋，任何段落最少播放 8 小節才可普通切換。
prompt.en: Build exploration, combat, and victory segments for a 100 BPM score; after a state change, transition no later than the next four-bar boundary, use a one-bar bridge from exploration to combat, and require an eight-bar minimum stay for ordinary switches.
prompt.ja: 100 BPMの楽曲に探索・戦闘・勝利の3セグメントを作ってください。状態変更後は遅くとも次の4小節境界で切り替え、探索から戦闘へは1小節のブリッジを使い、通常の切り替えでは各セグメントを最低8小節再生してください。

FX-31.params: cue length · beat quantization · overlay gain · cooldown · event priority · tonal variant · interruption rule
FX-31.impl: Overlay a short musical phrase on the continuing score and schedule it at an appropriate beat or bar when latency permits. Define priority and cooldown rules so frequent events do not create musical clutter.

prompt.zh: 拾到稀有物件時，在持續配樂上疊加 1.5 秒音樂短句；若下一拍在 250 毫秒內便等到拍點播放，否則立即播放，同類短句設 3 秒冷卻，音量峰值比配樂高 3 dB。
prompt.en: When a rare item is collected, overlay a 1.5-second musical stinger on the continuing score; if the next beat is within 250 ms, wait for it, otherwise play immediately, with a 3-second same-type cooldown and a peak 3 dB above the score.
prompt.ja: レアアイテム取得時、継続中の曲に1.5秒のスティンガーを重ねてください。次の拍まで250ミリ秒以内なら拍に合わせ、それ以上なら即時再生し、同種には3秒のクールダウンを設け、ピークを楽曲より3 dB高くしてください。

FX-32.params: amplitude · duration · motor balance · attack · release · event priority · device fallback
FX-32.impl: Trigger a bounded haptic envelope for the event and adapt it to the capabilities exposed by each device. Treat haptics as an additional channel, preserving equivalent visual or audio feedback when unavailable.

prompt.zh: 角色由 3 米高處落地時播放 180 毫秒震動：20 毫秒升至 65% 強度、維持 80 毫秒，再於 80 毫秒降至 0；裝置不支援震動或玩家關閉時，仍保留畫面及聲音確認。
prompt.en: For a landing from 3 m, play a 180 ms vibration that rises to 65% intensity in 20 ms, holds for 80 ms, and releases to zero over 80 ms; preserve visual and audio confirmation when vibration is unsupported or disabled.
prompt.ja: 3 mの高さから着地したとき、180ミリ秒の振動を再生してください。20ミリ秒で強度65%まで上げ、80ミリ秒維持し、80ミリ秒でゼロへ戻し、振動非対応または無効時も映像と音の確認を残してください。

FX-33.params: pulse count · pulse duration · interval · amplitude profile · pattern length · overlap priority · recognition test
FX-33.impl: Assign events distinct temporal envelopes rather than differentiating them only by strength. Resolve overlaps by priority or blending, and validate recognition with users while retaining non-haptic cues.

prompt.zh: 設定 3 種震動模式：命中為 1 次 60 毫秒脈衝、警告為 3 次各 80 毫秒且相隔 120 毫秒、持續受傷為每 500 毫秒 1 次 150 毫秒脈衝；以 12 名測試者驗證，不可把震動當唯一提示。
prompt.en: Define three haptic patterns: one 60 ms pulse for a hit, three 80 ms pulses separated by 120 ms for a warning, and one 150 ms pulse every 500 ms for ongoing damage; test recognition with 12 participants and never use vibration as the sole cue.
prompt.ja: 振動パターンを3種類設定してください。命中は60ミリ秒を1回、警告は80ミリ秒を120ミリ秒間隔で3回、継続ダメージは500ミリ秒ごとに150ミリ秒を1回とし、12人で識別性を確認して、振動だけを唯一の合図にしないでください。

FX-34.params: master toggle · intensity steps · per-device scaling · default value · preview pattern · persistent setting · non-haptic fallback
FX-34.impl: Expose a persistent master toggle and adjustable intensity, then scale requests through each device’s capability range. Ensure disabling haptics removes no gameplay information and do not describe percentage values as physical safety measurements.

prompt.zh: 在設定加入震動總開關、0–100% 強度滑桿和 1 秒預覽模式，預設 50%，每次調整以 5% 為一步並儲存至玩家設定；關閉後用畫面及聲音保留全部必要警告。
prompt.en: Add a master vibration toggle, a 0–100% intensity slider, and a one-second preview, defaulting to 50% with 5% steps and persistent storage; when disabled, retain every essential warning through visual and audio cues.
prompt.ja: 設定に振動の全体スイッチ、0～100%の強度スライダー、1秒のプレビューを追加してください。初期値は50%、5%刻みで保存し、無効時も必要な警告を映像と音ですべて維持してください。

FX-35.params: visual cue · audio cue · haptic cue · channel toggle · semantic match · timing tolerance · fallback audit
FX-35.impl: Encode the same event meaning across independent sensory channels with closely aligned timing and consistent urgency. Audit every channel-off combination so no required information depends on one sense or device.

prompt.zh: 為 1 秒後爆炸的危險加入紅白邊界圖形、每 250 毫秒加速的警告音和可選 3 脈衝震動，三者起始時間相差不多於 50 毫秒；逐一關閉聲音、震動或畫面輔助測試資訊是否仍完整。
prompt.en: For a hazard that explodes in one second, provide a red-and-white boundary graphic, a warning tone accelerating every 250 ms, and an optional three-pulse vibration, with channel onsets within 50 ms; test each sound-off, haptics-off, and visual-assist-off combination for complete information.
prompt.ja: 1秒後に爆発する危険に、赤白の境界表示、250ミリ秒ごとに加速する警告音、任意の3パルス振動を用意し、各開始時刻の差を50ミリ秒以内にしてください。音・振動・視覚補助を個別に切った状態でも情報が完全か確認してください。

FX-36.params: sound label · source identity · direction · distance band · display duration · priority · concurrency limit
FX-36.impl: Convert important non-speech sounds into concise text and directional visuals using source metadata. Prioritize and merge repeated cues to prevent captions from obscuring the scene, and do not rely on arrows alone to communicate sound identity.

prompt.zh: 敵人敲門時顯示「〔右後方 8 米：急促敲門聲〕」2 秒，方向每 100 毫秒更新；同時最多顯示 3 條音效字幕，0.5 秒內同類腳步合併為 1 條並保留方向。
prompt.en: When an enemy knocks, display “[8 m, rear right: rapid knocking]” for two seconds and update direction every 100 ms; show at most three sound captions at once and merge same-type footsteps within 0.5 seconds while retaining direction.
prompt.ja: 敵がドアを叩いたら「［右後方8 m：激しいノック音］」を2秒表示し、方向を100ミリ秒ごとに更新してください。同時表示は最大3件とし、0.5秒以内の同種の足音は方向を残して1件にまとめてください。

FX-37.params: camera shake scale · motion blur toggle · flash reduction · essential motion floor · preview · per-effect override · fallback feedback
FX-37.impl: Provide controls that reduce nonessential camera and effect motion while preserving aiming, hazard boundaries, and spatial information. Replace disabled motion-based feedback with stable visual or audio confirmation and test the complete gameplay flow.

prompt.zh: 加入「減少動態」設定：鏡頭震動可選 0%、25%、50%、100%，motion blur 可獨立關閉；設為 0% 時以 0.12 秒命中輪廓和短音效補回確認，並測試 10 個主要攻擊。
prompt.en: Add a Reduced Motion setting with camera shake at 0%, 25%, 50%, or 100% and an independent motion-blur toggle; at 0% shake, replace hit feedback with a 0.12-second outline and short sound, then test all 10 major attacks.
prompt.ja: 「動きの軽減」設定を追加し、カメラ振動を0%、25%、50%、100%から選べるようにし、モーションブラーは個別に無効化してください。振動0%では0.12秒の命中輪郭と短い音で補い、主要攻撃10種類を確認してください。

FX-38.params: full-frame capture · flash analysis · red-flash review · pattern contrast · overlap scenario · mitigation variant · tool report
FX-38.impl: Analyze captured final gameplay output, including overlapping effects and post-processing, with an appropriate photosensitivity risk tool. Review flagged intervals manually, reduce or replace risky presentation, and avoid treating a passing result as a medical guarantee.

prompt.zh: 擷取 30 分鐘、60 fps 的實際遊戲合成畫面，包含 6 個效果同時疊加的最壞情況；用合適工具分析全屏閃光、紅閃和高對比圖樣，逐項複核所有標記時段，輸出原版與 2 個減風險版本，不可聲稱絕對安全。
prompt.en: Capture 30 minutes of final gameplay output at 60 fps, including a worst case with six overlapping effects; analyze full-screen flashes, red flashes, and high-contrast patterns with an appropriate tool, manually review every flagged interval, and produce the original plus two reduced-risk variants without claiming absolute safety.
prompt.ja: 6個のエフェクトが重なる最悪条件を含め、最終ゲーム映像を60 fpsで30分キャプチャしてください。適切なツールで全画面フラッシュ、赤色フラッシュ、高コントラストパターンを分析し、検出区間をすべて手動確認して、原版とリスク低減版2案を作成し、絶対的な安全性は主張しないでください。

UX-01.params: health · ammunition · compass · visibility rules · safe margins · combat state
UX-01.impl: Bind each HUD element to live player state and a small set of visibility states such as exploration, combat, and menus. Keep critical status readable within safe margins, and fade only information that is not currently needed.

prompt.zh: 設計一個 16:9 戰鬥 HUD：左下顯示 0–100 血量，右下顯示 30/120 彈藥，上方顯示 8 方位指南針；脫離戰鬥 5 秒後淡出彈藥，但血量低於 25% 時必須保留。
prompt.en: Design a 16:9 combat HUD with 0–100 health at bottom left, 30/120 ammunition at bottom right, and an 8-point compass at the top; fade ammunition 5 seconds after combat, but keep health visible below 25%.
prompt.ja: 16:9の戦闘HUDを設計し、左下に0～100のHP、右下に30/120の弾薬、上部に8方位コンパスを表示してください。戦闘終了から5秒後に弾薬表示を消し、HPが25%未満ならHP表示は残してください。

UX-02.params: current value · maximum value · segments · percentage · low-state cue · color-independent coding
UX-02.impl: Map the meter fill to the documented value scale and pair color with text, shape, or pattern. Define explicit thresholds and animate value changes briefly without delaying the underlying state update.

prompt.zh: 製作血量及耐力量表：血量以 0–100% 長條加數字顯示，低於 20% 時加入斜紋及「危急」文字；耐力分成 5 格，每次動作用 1 格，不能只靠紅綠色傳意。
prompt.en: Create health and stamina meters: show health as a 0–100% bar plus a number, add hatching and a Critical label below 20%, and divide stamina into 5 segments consumed 1 at a time without relying on red and green alone.
prompt.ja: HPとスタミナのゲージを作成してください。HPは0～100%のバーと数値で示し、20%未満では斜線パターンと「危険」を追加します。スタミナは5区画で、行動ごとに1区画消費し、赤と緑だけに依存しないでください。

UX-03.params: center point · spread radius · weapon state · target feedback · trajectory offset · contrast
UX-03.impl: Render the reticle as an aiming reference driven by weapon spread and interaction state, while leaving hit resolution to gameplay rules. If projectile drop or offset matters, communicate uncertainty rather than promising an exact impact point.

prompt.zh: 設計一個準星：靜止時半徑 6 px、移動時擴至 18 px、裝填時變成虛線；另以獨立落點提示 20 m 距離的彈道下墜，並明確避免令玩家以為準星代表必中。
prompt.en: Design a reticle with a 6 px radius while still, expanding to 18 px while moving and becoming dashed during reload; add a separate impact cue for projectile drop at 20 m without implying a guaranteed hit.
prompt.ja: 照準表示を設計してください。静止時は半径6px、移動時は18pxに広げ、リロード中は破線にします。20m先の弾道落下は別の着弾目安で示し、命中保証に見えないようにしてください。

UX-04.params: world marker · distance · objective text · progress count · occlusion · route context
UX-04.impl: Treat the waypoint and objective tracker as separate components backed by the same objective state. Clamp off-screen markers, state whether they are occluded, and avoid presenting a straight-line marker as a traversable route.

prompt.zh: 建立任務導引：世界標記顯示「發電機」及 142 m，畫面右側追蹤「啟動發電機 1/3」；標記被牆遮住時改為空心，距離少於 10 m 才顯示入口提示，不要假裝直線就是可行路線。
prompt.en: Build objective guidance with a world marker labeled Generator at 142 m and a side tracker reading Activate generators 1/3; make the marker hollow through walls and show an entrance cue only within 10 m rather than implying a straight traversable route.
prompt.ja: 目標案内を作成し、ワールドマーカーに「発電機」と142m、画面右側に「発電機を起動 1/3」と表示してください。壁越しではマーカーを中抜きにし、10m以内でのみ入口案内を出して、直線が通行可能な経路だと誤解させないでください。

UX-05.params: interaction range · facing angle · action label · bound input · priority · dismissal
UX-05.impl: Evaluate prompts from current range, facing, eligibility, and interaction priority, then display the actual bound input. Remove the prompt when those conditions fail, not because the system assumes the player has learned it.

prompt.zh: 製作情境操作提示：玩家在箱子 2 m 內並面向它 45° 以內時顯示「E 開啟」，改鍵後即時換成新按鍵；離開範圍 0.3 秒後隱藏，附近有 2 個目標時優先顯示最近可用的一個。
prompt.en: Create a contextual prompt that shows E: Open when the player is within 2 m of a chest and facing it within 45 degrees, updates immediately after rebinding, hides 0.3 seconds after leaving range, and prioritizes the nearest valid target when 2 overlap.
prompt.ja: 状況依存プロンプトを作成してください。宝箱から2m以内かつ向きが45度以内なら「E 開ける」を表示し、キー変更後は即時更新します。範囲外になって0.3秒後に消し、対象が2つ重なる場合は最も近い有効対象を優先してください。

UX-06.params: focus ring · selected state · hover state · input method · contrast · focus restore
UX-06.impl: Represent focus, hover, and selected or equipped state with distinct visual tokens. Maintain a single logical focus target and restore it predictably when a panel or dialog closes.

prompt.zh: 設計 3×2 裝備格：手把焦點用 3 px 實線框，滑鼠 hover 用淺底色，已裝備物品用剔號；三種狀態可同時存在但不能混淆，關閉詳情頁後要回到原本第 4 格。
prompt.en: Design a 3-by-2 equipment grid using a 3 px solid ring for controller focus, a light background for mouse hover, and a checkmark for equipped items; allow states to coexist without confusion and restore focus to slot 4 after closing details.
prompt.ja: 3×2の装備グリッドを設計してください。コントローラーのフォーカスは3pxの実線枠、マウスホバーは薄い背景、装備中はチェックで示します。3状態が同時でも区別でき、詳細を閉じたら4番目の枠へ戻してください。

UX-07.params: tab order · directional neighbors · confirm · back · wrapping · focus memory
UX-07.impl: Define explicit directional neighbors for non-linear layouts and a stable order for linear lists. Preserve focus per tab, keep confirm and back behavior consistent, and test every path without a pointer.

prompt.zh: 建立「裝備／地圖／技能」3 個分頁及每頁 4×3 項目網格；左右肩鍵切頁，方向鍵按視覺鄰位移動，網格邊緣不循環，返回上一頁時恢復各分頁最後焦點。
prompt.en: Build 3 tabs—Equipment, Map, and Skills—with a 4-by-3 item grid on each; use shoulder buttons for tabs, move focus to visual neighbors with directional input, do not wrap at grid edges, and restore each tab’s last focus on return.
prompt.ja: 「装備／マップ／スキル」の3タブと、各タブに4×3の項目グリッドを作成してください。ショルダーボタンでタブを切り替え、方向入力では見た目上の隣へ移動し、端では循環させず、戻った際は各タブの最後のフォーカスを復元してください。

UX-08.params: blocking state · initial focus · focus containment · confirm · cancel · background input
UX-08.impl: Place a modal in a dedicated blocking layer, move focus to a safe initial action, and contain navigation until the dialog resolves. Disable background interaction, restore prior focus on close, and do not infer that simulation is paused.

prompt.zh: 製作刪除存檔模態框，顯示「刪除第 3 個存檔？」及「取消／刪除」2 個按鈕；初始焦點放在取消，Tab 只能在框內循環，Esc 關閉後回到第 3 個存檔，背景遊戲仍可按產品規則繼續。
prompt.en: Create a delete-save modal asking Delete save 3? with 2 buttons, Cancel and Delete; put initial focus on Cancel, keep Tab inside the dialog, restore focus to save 3 on Escape, and do not assume the background simulation pauses.
prompt.ja: 「セーブ3を削除しますか？」と「キャンセル／削除」の2ボタンを持つモーダルを作成してください。初期フォーカスはキャンセルに置き、Tabはダイアログ内に限定し、Escで閉じた後はセーブ3へ戻し、背後のゲーム停止は別ルールとして扱ってください。

UX-09.params: primary settings · advanced section · disclosure control · persisted state · search · importance
UX-09.impl: Show frequent and safety-critical controls at the first level, with optional details behind a clearly labeled disclosure control. Preserve the expanded state when useful and ensure hidden options remain discoverable through labels or search.

prompt.zh: 整理設定頁：首層顯示主音量、字幕及文字大小 3 項，按「進階音訊」才展開動態範圍等 5 項；字幕不能收起，搜尋「夜間」要直接找到隱藏選項，展開狀態在同一工作階段保留。
prompt.en: Organize a settings page with 3 first-level controls—master volume, subtitles, and text size—and reveal 5 less-used options under Advanced Audio; never hide subtitles, let a search for night find the concealed option, and preserve expansion for the session.
prompt.ja: 設定画面を整理し、最初にマスター音量、字幕、文字サイズの3項目を表示し、「高度な音声」で使用頻度の低い5項目を展開してください。字幕は隠さず、「夜間」の検索で非表示項目へ直接移動でき、展開状態は同一セッション中保持してください。

UX-10.params: speaker label · dialogue · sound cue · direction · line length · display duration
UX-10.impl: Build captions from timed dialogue and meaningful non-speech events, with optional speaker and direction metadata. Limit line length, guarantee sufficient reading time, and omit ambient sounds that do not affect understanding or decisions.

prompt.zh: 設計字幕／CC：每行最多 42 個字元、最多 2 行、最少顯示 2 秒；對白標示講者，將重要聲音寫成「［背後腳步］」並加方向箭嘴，但不要逐一轉錄連續 10 秒的無關風聲。
prompt.en: Design subtitles and closed captions with at most 42 characters per line, 2 lines, and a 2-second minimum duration; identify speakers, caption important audio as [Footsteps behind] with direction, and omit 10 seconds of irrelevant wind ambience.
prompt.ja: 字幕／CCを設計し、1行42文字以内、最大2行、最低2秒表示にしてください。話者名を示し、重要音は方向付きで「［背後の足音］」と表示し、10秒続く無関係な風音は逐語化しないでください。

UX-11.params: world ownership · character access · physical placement · legibility · interaction distance · fallback
UX-11.impl: Anchor the interface to an object acknowledged by the fictional world and let character actions operate it. Preserve readability across viewing distances and provide a fallback when perspective, lighting, or occlusion makes the in-world surface unusable.

prompt.zh: 設計角色世界內的氧氣手錶：錶面顯示 0–100% 及剩餘 12:30，角色抬手 0.4 秒後才可讀；在強光下加入高對比模式，數值低於 15% 時由手錶本身發出警示。
prompt.en: Design an in-world oxygen watch showing 0–100% and 12:30 remaining, readable after a 0.4-second raise-hand action; add a high-contrast mode for bright light and have the watch itself warn below 15%.
prompt.ja: 物語世界内に存在する酸素腕時計を設計し、0～100%と残り12:30を表示してください。腕を上げて0.4秒後に読めるようにし、強い光では高コントラスト表示、15%未満では腕時計自体が警告するようにしてください。

UX-12.params: player-only data · screen anchor · inventory slots · health value · visual theme · visibility
UX-12.impl: Render player-only information in a screen-anchored layer independent of world objects. It may share the setting’s visual language, but its visibility and behavior should be governed by player information needs rather than fictional-world access.

prompt.zh: 製作玩家專用疊加介面：左上固定顯示 73/100 血量，底部顯示 8 格快捷欄；即使鏡頭轉動亦保持位置，選單採舊紙風格但不要暗示角色真的看見這些數值。
prompt.en: Create a player-only overlay with 73/100 health fixed at top left and an 8-slot quick bar at the bottom; keep positions stable as the camera turns, and use an old-paper style without implying the character literally sees these values.
prompt.ja: プレイヤー専用オーバーレイを作成し、左上に73/100のHP、下部に8枠のクイックバーを固定表示してください。カメラ回転でも位置を維持し、古紙風の見た目でもキャラクターが数値を実際に見ているとは扱わないでください。

UX-13.params: world anchor · screen projection · distance scaling · occlusion · edge clamping · narrative status
UX-13.impl: Attach each cue to a world position, then choose world rendering or screen projection independently of its narrative classification. Define distance, occlusion, overlap, and off-screen behavior so spatial relationships remain understandable.

prompt.zh: 設計 4 個隊友頭頂名牌及一條地面導航線：名牌在 5–30 m 內縮放，被牆遮住時隱藏，離屏時只保留隊長箭嘴；這些提示連結場景位置，但不當作角色世界內實物。
prompt.en: Design nameplates for 4 teammates plus a ground navigation trail: scale nameplates from 5–30 m, hide them behind walls, and retain only the leader arrow off-screen; keep them spatially anchored without treating them as physical world objects.
prompt.ja: 4人の仲間の頭上ネームプレートと地面の誘導線を設計してください。ネームプレートは5～30mで縮尺を変え、壁の裏では隠し、画面外ではリーダーの矢印だけを残します。空間に結び付けつつ、世界内の実物とは扱わないでください。

UX-14.params: injury intensity · screen edge · status mapping · fade timing · accessibility · competing effects
UX-14.impl: Drive screen effects from the character state with bounded intensity and a clear recovery curve. Keep essential scene and interface details visible, offer intensity controls, and avoid classifying every stylized overlay as the same narrative device.

prompt.zh: 設計受傷 meta UI：血量由 40% 降至 15% 時，畫面邊緣污跡透明度由 10% 升至 35%，回復後 1.5 秒淡走；中央 60% 畫面不得被遮，並提供 0／50／100% 效果強度設定。
prompt.en: Design injury meta UI where edge grime rises from 10% to 35% opacity as health drops from 40% to 15%, then fades over 1.5 seconds after recovery; never obscure the central 60% and offer 0, 50, and 100% intensity settings.
prompt.ja: 負傷状態のメタUIを設計してください。HPが40%から15%へ下がる間、画面端の汚れを不透明度10%から35%へ増やし、回復後1.5秒で消します。中央60%は遮らず、効果強度0／50／100%を用意してください。

UX-15.params: coordinate space · perspective · occlusion · projection · screen anchor · distance
UX-15.impl: Choose world or screen coordinates according to the desired perspective, occlusion, and stability. A world-following cue may still be projected and drawn in screen space, so keep coordinate implementation separate from diegetic classification.

prompt.zh: 比較 2 種介面：牆上 1×0.6 m 面板要隨透視縮放並可被柱遮擋；右上任務卡固定於離畫面邊 32 px。敵人頭頂血條用 3D 點投影至 2D，不要因而稱它為故事內介面。
prompt.en: Implement 2 interface spaces: a 1-by-0.6 m wall panel that scales with perspective and can be occluded by a pillar, and an objective card fixed 32 px from the top-right edge; project enemy head positions into 2D for health bars without calling them diegetic.
prompt.ja: 2種類のUI空間を実装してください。壁の1×0.6mパネルは遠近で縮小し柱に隠れ、目標カードは右上端から32pxに固定します。敵頭上のHPバーは3D座標を2Dへ投影し、それだけで世界内UIとは分類しないでください。

UX-16.params: transition duration · easing · focus animation · input lock · reduced motion · state continuity
UX-16.impl: Use motion to explain state changes while keeping focus and input outcomes immediately legible. Cap transition durations, define interruption behavior, and provide a reduced-motion path that preserves function without large movement or flashing.

prompt.zh: 設計分頁轉場：面板在 180 ms 內滑動，焦點框用 120 ms 淡變，轉場途中仍顯示目前分頁；連按 3 次切頁時直接追到最新輸入，減少動態模式改用 80 ms 交叉淡入。
prompt.en: Design tab transitions with a 180 ms panel slide and a 120 ms focus fade while always showing the current tab; if 3 tab inputs arrive quickly, resolve to the latest one, and use an 80 ms crossfade in reduced-motion mode.
prompt.ja: タブ遷移を設計し、パネルは180msでスライド、フォーカス枠は120msで変化させ、遷移中も現在のタブを示してください。3回連続入力されたら最新へ追従し、モーション低減時は80msのクロスフェードにしてください。

UX-17.params: hit event · relative direction · arc width · health delta · audio cue · decay
UX-17.impl: Convert incoming-hit direction into a screen-relative sector and combine it with health and audio or haptic feedback. Use the cue for approximate threat direction only, with decay and overlap rules for multiple attackers.

prompt.zh: 製作方向受傷提示：來襲方向量化成 8 個扇區，顯示 70° 弧線 0.8 秒，同步扣除 18 點血及播放痛叫；1 秒內有 3 次攻擊時可疊加強度，但不可把弧線當敵人精確座標或命中敵人的 hit marker。
prompt.en: Create directional damage feedback using 8 incoming sectors, a 70-degree arc lasting 0.8 seconds, an 18-point health loss, and a pain sound; accumulate intensity for 3 hits within 1 second without implying an exact enemy position or a hit marker.
prompt.ja: 方向付き被ダメージ表示を作成してください。攻撃方向を8区分にし、70度の弧を0.8秒表示し、HPを18減らして痛みの音を同期します。1秒以内の3回攻撃は強度を加算しても、敵の正確な位置や命中マーカーとは扱わないでください。

UX-18.params: visual cue · audio cue · haptic cue · semantic equivalence · channel controls · intensity
UX-18.impl: Publish one semantic event to visual, audio, and haptic presenters so each channel communicates the same core fact. Let players adjust or disable channels independently, and avoid multiplying intensity merely because several channels are active.

prompt.zh: 為新任務提供 3 通道回饋：顯示 4 秒文字及菱形圖案、播放 0.6 秒提示音、震動 150 ms；任何一個通道關閉後仍可理解「新任務已加入」，紅色加綠色不可當作兩個感官通道。
prompt.en: Provide 3-channel feedback for a new objective: show text and a diamond icon for 4 seconds, play a 0.6-second sound, and vibrate for 150 ms; the event must remain understandable with any channel disabled, and red plus green does not count as 2 channels.
prompt.ja: 新しい目標に3経路のフィードバックを用意してください。文字とひし形を4秒表示し、0.6秒の音と150msの振動を出します。どの経路を無効にしても「新目標追加」が理解でき、赤と緑を2つの感覚経路とは数えないでください。

UX-20.params: camera shake · head bob · menu motion · auto-scroll · flashing · intensity preset
UX-20.impl: Expose independent controls for nonessential camera, interface, scrolling, and flashing effects, plus a convenient reduced-motion preset. Replace large movement with stable state changes while retaining all information and actions.

prompt.zh: 加入減少動態設定：鏡頭震動 0–100%、頭部晃動開關、選單背景動畫開關、自動滾動開關；啟用預設後將震動降至 10%、停用晃動及滑入，但保留相同 6 個功能及清楚焦點。
prompt.en: Add reduced-motion settings for 0–100% camera shake, head bob, animated menu backgrounds, and auto-scroll; the preset should set shake to 10%, disable bob and sliding, and preserve the same 6 functions and clear focus.
prompt.ja: モーション低減設定を追加し、カメラ揺れ0～100%、頭部の上下動、メニュー背景アニメ、自動スクロールを個別設定できるようにしてください。プリセットでは揺れを10%にし、上下動とスライドを止めても同じ6機能と明確なフォーカスを保ってください。

UX-21.params: actor capability · object property · rule check · action range · state change · failure reason
UX-21.impl: Compute affordance from the relationship between actor capabilities, object properties, and current rules. Expose a consistent action result and a useful failure reason, while leaving visual communication of that possibility to separate signifiers.

prompt.zh: 定義翻越可行性：角色跳躍高度 1.2 m，只有 0.4–1.0 m 高且上方有 0.6 m 淨空的牆可翻；負重超過 30 kg 時不可翻並回報原因，牆面有沒有黃漆不能改變規則。
prompt.en: Define vault affordance for a character with a 1.2 m jump: only walls 0.4–1.0 m high with 0.6 m overhead clearance are vaultable; block the action above 30 kg carried weight and report why, regardless of yellow paint.
prompt.ja: 跳び越えのアフォーダンスを定義してください。ジャンプ高1.2mのキャラクターは、高さ0.4～1.0mで上に0.6mの空間がある壁だけ越えられます。所持重量30kg超では理由を示して禁止し、黄色い塗装の有無で規則を変えないでください。

UX-22.params: interaction outline · handle shape · action label · consistency · false cue · state cue
UX-22.impl: Use consistent visual, textual, or environmental cues to signal actual available actions and states. Generate cues from interaction eligibility where possible so decorative objects do not accidentally promise unavailable behavior.

prompt.zh: 為可用拉柄設計 3 個提示符：清楚把手形狀、2 px 輪廓及「拉下」文字；玩家在 3 m 內才顯示輪廓，已鎖定時改顯示鎖圖案，不可讓 5 個純裝飾拉柄使用同一醒目外觀。
prompt.en: Design 3 signifiers for a usable lever: a clear handle shape, a 2 px outline, and the label Pull; show the outline within 3 m, replace it with a lock symbol when disabled, and do not give 5 decorative levers the same conspicuous treatment.
prompt.ja: 使用可能なレバーに3つのシグニファイアを設計してください。明確な取っ手形状、2pxの輪郭、「引く」の文字を使い、3m以内で輪郭を表示し、ロック中は鍵記号へ変えます。装飾用レバー5個に同じ目立つ外観を使わないでください。

UX-23.params: current location · destination · route choice · landmarks · map · confirmation
UX-23.impl: Support orientation with recognizable area identity and support navigation with route choices, landmarks, maps, or signs. Confirm progress at decision points without forcing players onto a single route or invoking NPC pathfinding concepts.

prompt.zh: 設計 3 區導覽：玩家要先靠大鐘辨認自己在大堂，再從 2 個路口選實驗室或花園；每個路口提供地圖及地標確認，偏離主路 20 m 時只提示方位，不強迫返回。
prompt.en: Design navigation across 3 areas: players first identify the lobby by a large clock, then choose the laboratory or garden at 2 junctions; provide map and landmark confirmation at each junction, and show direction only after a 20 m deviation without forcing a return.
prompt.ja: 3エリアの案内を設計してください。大時計でロビーだと把握し、2つの分岐で研究室か庭園を選びます。各分岐に地図とランドマークの確認を置き、主経路から20m外れた場合も方向だけ示して帰還を強制しないでください。

UX-24.params: junction · arrow · destination label · arrival sign · readability distance · visual hierarchy
UX-24.impl: Place explicit signs where players make route decisions and confirmation signs where they arrive. Make destinations readable before the decision point and visually distinguish operational signage from decorative set dressing.

prompt.zh: 在 T 字路口前 8 m 放置方向牌，左箭嘴寫「醫療區 40 m」、右箭嘴寫「機庫 65 m」；門口再放 1 個區域名稱作抵達確認，文字須在 10 m 可讀並與 6 張裝飾海報分開。
prompt.en: Place a directional sign 8 m before a T-junction, with Medical 40 m to the left and Hangar 65 m to the right; add 1 arrival label above each doorway, readable from 10 m and visually distinct from 6 decorative posters.
prompt.ja: T字路の8m手前に方向標識を置き、左を「医療区画 40m」、右を「格納庫 65m」としてください。各入口には到着確認用の名称を1つ置き、10mから読め、6枚の装飾ポスターと区別できるようにしてください。

UX-25.params: distinct silhouette · multi-angle visibility · route reference · memory anchor · scale · POI distinction
UX-25.impl: Choose a landmark with a unique silhouette and expose it from relevant decision points with stable directional relationships. Test whether players can use it to describe and recover a route, rather than assuming any attractive point of interest provides navigation.

prompt.zh: 建立一座 30 m 高三角塔作地標，須從 3 個主要路口都看見並可用「塔底轉左」描述路線；另放 2 個只供探索的 POI，但不要假設看不見路口的漂亮雕像也能協助認路。
prompt.en: Create a 30 m triangular tower visible from 3 major junctions so routes can be described as turn left at the tower base; add 2 exploration-only POIs, but do not treat an attractive statue hidden from junctions as a navigational landmark.
prompt.ja: 高さ30mの三角形の塔をランドマークとして作り、主要な3分岐から見えて「塔の根元で左」と経路を説明できるようにしてください。探索用POIを2つ追加しても、分岐から見えない美しい像を案内用ランドマークとは扱わないでください。

UX-26.params: floor seams · rails · destination framing · traversable path · obstacle · validation
UX-26.impl: Compose lines and spatial forms so they visually point toward a relevant destination, then validate them against actual traversability and objective logic. Treat the composition as a supporting cue, never as a guarantee that attention or movement will follow it.

prompt.zh: 用 4 條地板接縫及 2 條電纜朝出口形成方向構圖，但在中間加入障礙，讓實際路線向右繞 6 m；再以可行路面及出口標記補足，不可假設玩家會無意識沿線直行。
prompt.en: Use 4 floor seams and 2 cables to point compositionally toward an exit, but place an obstacle requiring a 6 m detour to the right; reinforce the traversable route and exit separately rather than assuming players subconsciously follow the lines.
prompt.ja: 4本の床目地と2本のケーブルを出口へ向けて構図上の方向を作りつつ、中央の障害物により実際は右へ6m迂回させてください。通行可能面と出口表示でも補い、線に無意識で従うとは仮定しないでください。

UX-27.params: observer point · target point · occlusion · glass · shot blocking · route visibility
UX-27.impl: Evaluate visual connection separately from movement and projectile rules. Frame useful targets from likely observer positions, then record whether each intervening material blocks sight, traversal, or shots independently.

prompt.zh: 由走廊入口建立 25 m 視線至下一區出口，並讓玩家隔玻璃看到 1 個敵人；玻璃允許看見但阻擋步行及射擊，實際入口在右方 12 m，畫面要避免將可見誤讀成可直達。
prompt.en: Create a 25 m sightline from the corridor entrance to the next exit and show 1 enemy through glass; the glass permits sight but blocks movement and shots, while the actual entrance is 12 m to the right, so visibility must not imply direct access.
prompt.ja: 廊下入口から次の出口まで25mの視線を作り、ガラス越しに敵1体を見せてください。ガラスは視認のみ許可し、移動と射撃を遮断します。実際の入口は右12mに置き、見えることが直行可能だと誤解されないようにしてください。

UX-28.params: overlook height · preview targets · approach route · entrance visibility · descent · spatial plan
UX-28.impl: Reveal the next space from an approach or overlook before entry, framing the objective, hazards, and route into the area. Ensure the preview supports a usable spatial plan rather than functioning only as scenery.

prompt.zh: 設計一段 20 m 窄道通往高 6 m 的眺望位，玩家可先看見廣場內 3 個敵人、1 個出口及左側下降坡道；停留至少 2 秒後才進場，並確保入口與下去方法都清楚。
prompt.en: Design a 20 m narrow approach to a 6 m-high overlook where players can preview 3 enemies, 1 exit, and a descent ramp on the left; allow at least 2 seconds to observe before entry and make both the entrance and descent legible.
prompt.ja: 20mの狭いアプローチの先に高さ6mの見晴らし地点を設け、広場の敵3体、出口1つ、左側の下降スロープを先に見せてください。進入前に最低2秒観察でき、入口と降り方の両方が明確になるようにしてください。

UX-29.params: trail item · spacing · visibility chain · reward value · alternate reading · endpoint
UX-29.impl: Place a sequence of cues so at least the next one is discoverable from each pickup or trace. Balance their spacing and value so they invite exploration without making completion mandatory or assuming collection guarantees forward movement.

prompt.zh: 沿 35 m 支路放置 7 個金色補給物，每件相距 4–6 m，站在上一件位置至少看見下一件；終點是小型寶箱，但玩家收集 3 件後折返亦可，不要將它做成網站式層級 breadcrumb。
prompt.en: Place 7 golden supplies along a 35 m side path, spaced 4–6 m apart so the next is visible from the previous one; end at a small chest, but allow players to turn back after collecting 3 and do not present this as website hierarchy breadcrumbs.
prompt.ja: 35mの脇道に金色の補給物を7個、4～6m間隔で置き、前の位置から次が見えるようにしてください。終点は小箱にしつつ、3個回収して引き返してもよく、ウェブサイト階層のパンくずとは別物にしてください。

UX-30.params: exit lighting · area palette · symbol · luminance contrast · color-blind support · atmosphere
UX-30.impl: Use stable lighting and palette relationships to distinguish areas and emphasize relevant entrances, then reinforce them with shape, labels, or symbols. Verify luminance and context because the brightest object is not inherently the destination.

prompt.zh: 為 3 個區域設定穩定配色，並以較背景高 4.5:1 的門口燈光標出出口；醫療區同時用加號，機庫用三角形，不能只靠紅綠分辨，也不要令場內最亮的裝飾燈誤導玩家。
prompt.en: Give 3 areas stable palettes and mark exits with doorway lighting at 4.5:1 contrast against the background; also use a plus for Medical and a triangle for Hangar, avoiding red/green-only coding and misleading brighter decorative lights.
prompt.ja: 3エリアに一貫した配色を与え、背景に対して4.5:1のコントラストを持つ入口照明で出口を示してください。医療区画には十字、格納庫には三角も併用し、赤緑だけの区別や、より明るい装飾灯による誤誘導を避けてください。

UX-31.params: required objective · main route · optional branch · reward · rejoin point · player choice
UX-31.impl: Model required progression separately from optional branches and communicate their consequences without forbidding exploration. Let side paths rejoin cleanly and avoid equating the critical path with either the shortest geometry or the only valid play style.

prompt.zh: 設計 1 條主路經過必須啟動的 2 個開關，另加 2 條支路，各藏補給或故事；支路在 30–45 m 後接回主路，玩家可先探索，主路不必是幾何最短線。
prompt.en: Design 1 main progression route containing 2 required switches and 2 optional branches with supplies or story; rejoin each branch after 30–45 m, let players explore first, and do not require the main path to be geometrically shortest.
prompt.ja: 必須起動するスイッチ2個を含むメインルート1本と、物資または物語を置く任意の脇道2本を設計してください。各脇道は30～45m後に本線へ戻し、先に探索できるようにし、メインルートを幾何学的最短路に限定しないでください。

UX-32.params: blocking condition · hard barrier · progress count · unlock event · feedback · persistence
UX-32.impl: Represent the gate as a rule that fully blocks passage until an explicit condition becomes true. Show condition progress and failure feedback, then transition the barrier once and persist the unlocked state as required.

prompt.zh: 建立硬門檻：閘門在敵人計數 4/4 未清除前完全阻擋，靠近時顯示「清除敵人 2/4」；歸零後 1.2 秒開門並永久記錄已解鎖，不能靠翻滾或繞邊穿過。
prompt.en: Build a hard gate that completely blocks passage until all 4 enemies are cleared, showing Clear enemies 2/4 on approach; open it over 1.2 seconds at zero, persist the unlock, and prevent rolling or edge bypasses.
prompt.ja: 敵4体をすべて倒すまで完全に通行を阻むハードゲートを作成し、接近時に「敵を倒す 2/4」と表示してください。残数0で1.2秒かけて開き、解除状態を保存し、回避や端抜けで通れないようにしてください。

UX-33.params: pressure source · traversal cost · bypass chance · risk signal · alternate preparation · progression role
UX-33.impl: Create a passage that remains technically possible while imposing a meaningful cost or risk that usually encourages preparation or delay. Confirm that the pressure actually regulates access, rather than labeling any difficult encounter a soft gate.

prompt.zh: 設計軟門檻：出口機關要持續操作 4 秒，期間有 3 名敵人射擊；熟練玩家可用 2 個煙霧彈強行通過，一般玩家則先清場，介面要顯示風險但不可把出口絕對鎖死。
prompt.en: Design a soft gate where an exit control requires a 4-second hold under fire from 3 enemies; skilled players may rush it using 2 smoke grenades while most clear the room first, and the UI should signal risk without locking the exit absolutely.
prompt.ja: 出口装置を4秒間操作する間に敵3体から攻撃されるソフトゲートを設計してください。熟練者はスモーク2個で強行でき、通常は先に排除する想定とし、危険を示しても出口を完全ロックしないでください。

UX-34.params: locked obstacle · key state · ability prerequisite · foreshadowing · return route · unlock feedback
UX-34.impl: Store the obstacle’s prerequisite as an explicit item, quest, or ability state and provide feedback both before and after acquisition. Preserve enough context or mapping for players to revisit earlier gates without confusing an unavailable ability with failure to perform it.

prompt.zh: 在第 1 區放置 2 面裂牆，首次檢查顯示「需要衝擊能力」；玩家在第 3 區解鎖能力後，地圖標記舊障礙並可返回破牆。不要要求額外操作考試，也不要把能力未解鎖寫成玩家操作失敗。
prompt.en: Place 2 cracked walls in area 1 that report Impact ability required; after unlocking the ability in area 3, mark the old obstacles on the map and allow return to break them, without adding a separate skill test or treating the locked ability as player error.
prompt.ja: エリア1にひび割れ壁を2枚置き、初回は「衝撃能力が必要」と表示してください。エリア3で能力を解放した後は古い障害を地図に示し、戻って破壊できるようにします。別の操作試験を課さず、未解放を操作ミスとは表示しないでください。

UX-35.params: one-way edge · return scope · warning · local loop · point of no return · save state
UX-35.impl: Encode the connection as one-way and state exactly which area or route becomes inaccessible. Reserve stronger point-of-no-return warnings for larger irreversible progression changes, and verify save and collectible consequences before committing.

prompt.zh: 設計一個 3 m 高落差作局部單向入口，落下後不能原路返回但可在 8 分鐘內經另一通道繞回；另在章末真正無法回到前 4 區前顯示一次確認，清楚列出未完成支線數目。
prompt.en: Design a 3 m drop as a local one-way entrance that cannot be climbed back but loops around within about 8 minutes; separately show one confirmation before the chapter-ending point of no return to the previous 4 areas, listing unfinished side objectives.
prompt.ja: 高さ3mの落差を局所的な一方通行入口として設計し、同じ道では戻れないものの約8分で別経路から戻れるようにしてください。章末で過去4エリアへ本当に戻れなくなる前には、未完了の脇目標数を示す確認を1回表示してください。

UX-36.params: initial blockage · far-side unlock · loopback · travel reduction · spatial reveal · persistent state
UX-36.impl: Present the shortcut as blocked on first contact, then allow it to be opened only after reaching the far side through the long route. Persist the change and make the new connection legible as part of the area’s topology, not as teleportation.

prompt.zh: 玩家首次由大堂看到鎖住鐵門，要繞行 180 m 到背面才可開；解鎖後兩區距離縮至 25 m，地圖即時畫出連線並永久保留，不能用快速傳送或單純短路徑冒充捷徑。
prompt.en: Show a locked iron gate from the lobby, requiring a 180 m route to reach and open its far side; afterward reduce travel between the areas to 25 m, update the map connection, persist it, and do not substitute fast travel or an always-open short path.
prompt.ja: ロビーから施錠された鉄門を見せ、反対側へ到達して開けるまで180mの迂回を必要にしてください。解除後は両区域間を25mに短縮し、地図へ接続を即時追加して保存し、ファストトラベルや最初から開いた短路で代用しないでください。

UX-37.params: safe practice · contextual prompt · repetition · application · mastery check · skip support
UX-37.impl: Teach one action at a time through a safe prompt, immediate practice, and a later situation that reuses it with meaningful context. Observe successful use rather than assuming a displayed instruction was learned, and support returning or experienced players without removing essential knowledge.

prompt.zh: 設計跳躍新手引導：先在無跌落風險位置顯示 1 次按鍵提示，讓玩家完成 3 次短跳；30 秒內安排 1 個 1.5 m 缺口作應用，失敗 2 次才重現提示，熟手可略過文字但不能略過必要能力授予。
prompt.en: Design jump onboarding with 1 control prompt in a no-fall area, 3 safe practice jumps, and a 1.5 m gap applying the action within 30 seconds; repeat the prompt only after 2 failures, and let experienced players skip text but not required ability grants.
prompt.ja: ジャンプ導入を設計し、落下しない場所で操作表示を1回出し、安全な短いジャンプを3回練習させ、30秒以内に幅1.5mの隙間で応用させてください。2回失敗した時だけ再表示し、経験者は文章を省略できても必要能力の付与は省かないでください。

UX-38.params: checkpoint trigger · respawn location · restored state · autosave · retry distance · quit behavior
UX-38.impl: Define checkpoint activation, respawn position, restored world and inventory state, and persistent save writes as separate rules. Test death, manual load, and quit-restart independently, including unsafe autosave prevention and retry distance.

prompt.zh: 設定 3 個檢查點，每段重試路程少於 45 秒；死亡後在最近旗點重生並保留已撿道具，但敵人重置。完成遭遇才自動存檔，戰鬥中不寫檔，並分別測試死亡、讀檔及退出重開 3 種恢復結果。
prompt.en: Configure 3 checkpoints with under 45 seconds of replay between them; on death respawn at the latest flag, retain collected items, and reset enemies. Autosave only after encounters, never mid-combat, and test death, load, and quit-restart as 3 distinct recovery paths.
prompt.ja: 3つのチェックポイントを設定し、再試行区間を45秒未満にしてください。死亡時は最新の旗で復活し、取得物は保持して敵はリセットします。オートセーブは戦闘終了後のみ行い、死亡、ロード、終了後再開の3経路を個別にテストしてください。
